title: What Lies Beyond Perception: A Partition Theory of the Limits of AI Evaluation and Oversight
title_zh: 超越感知的边界：AI评估与监督极限的划分理论

paragraphs.en: Replacing the judge can move a benchmark score, and models can be trained to hide capabilities. Both put the evaluator in question, not only the model: what can it certify? We develop a partition theory of evaluation from one principle: judgement is bounded by perception. An agent’s discrimination is the partition of its inputs into classes it cannot tell apart, and its outputs depend on an input only through that class. Discrimination is necessary for capability but not sufficient: a model cannot perform a task that requires a distinction it does not draw, and drawing the distinction does not ensure the task is done. Bounds on discrimination therefore bear directly on the question that matters most for safety: whether evaluation can show that a model lacks an ability. We prove a one-sided bound. An examinee whose partition refines its evaluator’s has the discrimination to pass every test the evaluator can grade, provided each input has an acceptable reply. We define the echo test, which sends an input and accepts any reply the evaluator perceives as identical to it. The echo test is complete for the tests the evaluator can grade, much as a complete problem stands for its complexity class: no test the evaluator can grade certifies more about an examinee’s discrimination. An examinee that conflates two inputs the evaluator separates fails it once both inputs are probed. Passing therefore certifies at most a floor on discrimination, never a ceiling. Further elicitation of the examinee cannot raise this floor; only a sharper evaluator can. Used to detect concealment, echo-test failure points the wrong way: under exhaustive probing, it flags every honestly weaker examinee and no concealer that presents as the evaluator’s peer. Exact imitation of a weaker model is undetectable by any behavioural evaluator. We extend the bound to several observers. An added monitor sharpens the evaluation only if it separates inputs that no existing monitor separates. A model that controls one channel, such as its reasoning trace, can hide only what the channels it cannot influence fail to separate, provided the evaluator checks the channels against one another. We use the theory to explain published findings on judge disagreement and sandbagging, and we derive predictions that experiments can test. Behavioural evaluation can establish that a model draws a distinction. Without the model’s cooperation, it cannot establish that the model lacks one.
paragraphs.zh: 更换评审者可以改变基准测试的分数，而模型可以被训练来隐藏能力。 两者都让评估者本身受到质疑，而不仅仅是模型：它到底能证明什么？ 我们从一个原理出发发展出一套评估的划分理论：判断受感知所限。 一个智能体的辨别力是将其输入划分为它无法区分类别的划分，其输出仅通过该类别依赖于输入。 辨别力是能力的必要条件但非充分条件：一个模型无法完成需要它未曾作出区分的任务，而作出了该区分也并不能确保任务被完成。 因此，辨别力的界限直接关系到对安全而言最重要的问题：评估能否证明一个模型缺乏某种能力。 我们证明了一个单侧界限。 一个应试者的划分若比其评估者的划分更细，且每个输入都存在可接受的回应，那么它具备通过该评估者所能判定的每一项测试所需的辨别力。 我们定义了回声测试，该测试发送一个输入，并接受评估者认为与该输入完全相同的任何回应。 回声测试对于评估者所能判定的测试而言是完全的，正如完全问题代表其复杂度类一样：评估者所能判定的任何测试都无法对应试者的辨别力给出更多证明。 若应试者将评估者能区分的两个输入混为一谈，那么一旦这两个输入都被探测，它就会失败。 因此，通过至多证明辨别力的下限，而绝非上限。 对应试者进一步的引导探询无法提高这一下限；只有更敏锐的评估者才能做到。 用于检测隐瞒行为时，回声测试的失败指向了错误的方向：在穷尽式探测下，它会标记出每一个诚实的较弱应试者，却标记不出任何表现得与评估者水平相当隐瞒者。 对较弱模型的精确模仿是任何行为评估者都无法察觉的。 我们将该界限扩展到多个观察者。 只有当新增的监视器能区分出所有现有监视器都无法区分的输入时，它才会使评估更加敏锐。 只要评估者对各通道进行交叉核对，一个控制了某一通道（如其推理轨迹）的模型，只能隐藏其无法影响的通道未能区分的内容。 我们运用该理论解释了已发表的关于评审者分歧与沙袋行为的研究结果，并推导出实验可检验的预测。 行为评估可以证明一个模型作出了某个区分。 在没有模型配合的情况下，它无法证明该模型缺乏某个区分。

paragraphs.en: It is by now a commonplace of AI evaluation that tests bound capability from below only. Barnett and Thiergart (2024) state it directly: evaluations “can establish lower bounds on AI capabilities” while facing “an inability to establish upper bounds on capabilities.” van der Weij et al. (2025) report the practical form: models can be fine-tuned to “approximately emulate a consistent capability profile of a weaker model.”
paragraphs.zh: 到如今，AI 评估领域的一个常识是：测试只能从下界约束能力。 Barnett 和 Thiergart（2024）直接指出了这一点：评估“只能确立 AI 能力的下界”，同时面临“无法确立能力上界”的困境。van der Weij 等人 （2025）报告了其实际形式：模型可以通过微调来“大致模拟一个较弱模型的稳定能力表现”。

paragraphs.en: The usual explanation is under-elicitation : a model may possess a capability that prompting, scaffolding or fine-tuning failed to surface, so a negative result does not establish absence, and a claim of the form “this model cannot do X X ” is only as good as the effort spent asking. That explanation concerns the examinee. Evaluations also depend on the evaluator: a benchmark score can move when the judge is replaced and the candidate responses are held fixed ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and a judge scores a candidate higher when that candidate’s mistakes resemble its own ( Goel et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 通常的解释是引导不足：模型可能具备某种能力，但提示、脚手架或微调未能将其激发出来，因此阴性结果并不能证明能力不存在，“该模型不能做X X”这类断言的可靠性完全取决于提问所付出的努力。 这一解释关注的是被评测者。 评测还依赖于评测者：在候选回答保持不变的情况下更换评判者，基准测试分数可能发生变化（Yang et al., 2026）；当候选者的错误与评判者自身的错误相似时，评判者会给该候选者打更高的分（Goel et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: This paper studies the evaluator. Its thesis is that judgement is bounded by perception: what an evaluator can certify is bounded by its resolution, the distinctions it can draw, under its current elicitation (Lemma 4 and Corollary 11 ). Mahran (2012) took the principle that judgement depends on perception, with a perception–action model of agents, to the question of whether agents can judge that they perceive alike, and concluded that a judge comparing percepts can certify a difference but not a sameness. Here that line is developed formally, as a partition theory, for the evaluation of AI systems. Model an agent by the partition its perception induces on the space of inputs: two inputs are equivalent for that agent when it cannot tell them apart. Subject to one axiom, that an agent’s output depends on its input only through its percept, two facts follow.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究评估器。 其论点是：判断受感知的限定——评估器在当前引导方式下能够认证的内容，受限于其分辨率，即它所能做出的区分（引理 4 与推论 11）。 Mahran（2012）秉持判断依赖于感知这一原则，采用智能体的感知–行动模型，研究了智能体能否判断它们的感知是否相同，其结论是：比较感知的评判者可以认证差异，但不能认证相同。 本文将这一路线形式化地发展为一种划分理论，用于对 AI 系统的评估。 用智能体的感知在输入空间上诱导的划分来对智能体建模：当该智能体无法区分两个输入时，这两个输入对该智能体而言是等价的。 在一条公理——智能体的输出仅通过其感知依赖于其输入——的约束下，可得出两个事实。

paragraphs.en: Suppose the examinee separates every pair of inputs its evaluator separates, and perhaps more. Then, if it knows how the evaluator perceives, it can work out which inputs the evaluator treats as the same, and answer as though it made no finer distinctions itself. Its extra resolution leaves no trace, and nothing in what the evaluator sees sets it apart from an agent that genuinely has no more.
paragraphs.zh: 假设考生分离其评估者所分离的每一对输入，甚至可能分离得更多。 那么，如果它知道评估者如何感知，它就能推算出评估者将哪些输入视为相同，并表现得好像自己没有做出更细的区分一样。 它多余的分辨力不会留下任何痕迹，评估者所见的一切也无法将它与真正没有更强分辨力的智能体区分开来。

sents.en: Suppose the examinee separates every pair of inputs its evaluator separates, and perhaps more.
sents.zh: 假设考生分离其评估者所分离的每一对输入，甚至可能分离得更多。

sents.en: Then, if it knows how the evaluator perceives, it can work out which inputs the evaluator treats as the same, and answer as though it made no finer distinctions itself.
sents.zh: 那么，如果它知道评估者如何感知，它就能推算出评估者将哪些输入视为相同，并表现得好像自己没有做出更细的区分一样。

sents.zh: 它多余的分辨力不会留下任何痕迹，评估者所见的一切也无法将它与真正没有更强分辨力的智能体区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Now suppose the opposite: some pair of inputs looks identical to the examinee and different to the evaluator. The examinee must answer both the same way, because it cannot see that they differ. The evaluator can, so it sees one answer where it expected two. That is a failure the examinee cannot avoid.
paragraphs.zh: 现在假设相反的情况：某一对输入在考生看来是相同的，而在评估者看来是不同的。 考生必须对两者给出相同的回答，因为它看不出它们的差异。 评估者却能看出差异，因此它看到的是一个答案，而它预期是两个。 这是考生无法避免的一种失败。

sents.en: Now suppose the opposite: some pair of inputs looks identical to the examinee and different to the evaluator.
sents.zh: 现在假设相反的情况：某一对输入在考生看来是相同的，而在评估者看来是不同的。

sents.en: The evaluator can, so it sees one answer where it expected two.
sents.zh: 评估者却能看出差异，因此它看到的是一个答案，而它预期是两个。

sents.en: That is a failure the examinee cannot avoid.
sents.zh: 这是考生无法避免的一种失败。

paragraphs.en: The two are not symmetric, and the reason is that discarding distinctions is easy and inventing them is not. An agent that sees finely can always group its percepts and act as though it saw less. An agent that sees coarsely cannot act as though it saw more: on any pair it has already conflated, its response is fixed. So discrimination above the evaluator’s resolution can be hidden and a shortfall below it is exposed, and exhaustive probing locates a floor while leaving everything above it open. We call the two emulation from above and detection from below (Theorems 7 and 9 ); together they give the one-sided bound.
paragraphs.zh: 二者并不对称，原因在于抹去区分是容易的，而发明区分则不然。 看得精细的智能体总能对其感知进行分组，表现得像看得更粗略一样。 看得粗略的智能体却无法表现得像看得更多一样：在任何一对它已经混淆的情形上，它的反应已经固定。 因此，高于评估者分辨率的区分能力可以被隐藏，而低于分辨率的不足则会暴露；穷举式探测能够定位一个下限，同时让下限之上的一切保持开放。 我们将二者分别称为自上而下的模拟与自下而上的检测（定理 7 与定理 9）；它们合起来给出了这个单边界。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator is not exempt. It is itself an agent, with its own limit on what it can tell apart, so what it establishes is bounded by that limit, and certifying the limit would take a sharper evaluator facing the same problem. Evaluations are run by agents, whether language models or humans, so this regress has no privileged end point.
paragraphs.zh: 评估者并非例外。 它本身就是一个智能体，在它能分辨什么方面同样有自身的限度，因此它所确立的东西也受限于这一限度，而要证明这一限度，又需要一个更敏锐的评估者去面对同样的问题。 评估都是由智能体进行的，无论是语言模型还是人类，所以这种回归没有特权的终点。

paragraphs.en: The most an evaluation can certify is therefore set by the evaluator’s resolution. Eliciting the examinee harder does not raise it, since a sharper examinee can reproduce whatever its evaluator expects however hard it is asked; eliciting the evaluator can.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一次评估所能证明的上限由评估者的分辨率决定。 加大对被评估智能体的引导力度并不能提高这一上限，因为更敏锐的智能体无论被如何追问，都能复现其评估者所期望的结果；而加大对评估者的引导力度则可以提高这一上限。

paragraphs.en: A sharper evaluator is the obvious remedy, and a real one. Three things about it are not obvious. The first is how sharp. The evaluator must separate the concealer’s reply from the reply of the agent it presents as, at some stimulus it probes (§ 4.4 ), a necessary condition, not a sufficient one (Remark 8 ), and not guaranteed by being merely sharper than the last evaluator. Behavioural effort spent on the examinee does not expose an exact copy, and neither does effort on the evaluator (Corollary 17 ); against inexact concealment, effort on the evaluator helps only up to the sharpest evaluator available; for a system at the frontier a single sharp enough evaluator may not exist. An ensemble offers a way round this. Its join separates every pair that some member separates (Definition 2 ), so a collection can be sharper than every one of its members, each supplying distinctions the others lack. The route to a sharper instrument can therefore run through diversity of discrimination as well as through a better individual judge. The second is that no warning is issued. By Corollary 11 passage says only that the examinee is somewhere above the evaluator, so a pass from an evaluator too coarse for the task looks exactly like a pass from an adequate one. The third is that the usual instruments do not act on this: harder items and richer scaffolds press on the examinee, and change nothing about what the instrument doing the reading can tell apart.
paragraphs.zh: 更锐利的评估器是显而易见的补救办法，而且是一个真正的补救办法。 关于它有三点并不显而易见。第一点是它能有多锐利。 评估器必须在它探测的某个刺激（见第 4.4 节）下，把隐藏者的回复与它所冒充的智能体的回复区分开来，这是一个必要条件而非充分条件（见注 8），并且仅比上一个评估器更锐利并不能保证这一点。 花在被考者身上的行为努力无法暴露一个精确的副本，花在评估器上的努力也一样（见推论 17）；面对不精确的隐藏，花在评估器上的努力只在达到现有最锐利的评估器之前有所帮助；对于处于前沿的系统来说，可能不存在单个足够锐利的评估器。 集成提供了一条绕过这一困境的途径。 其合并能区分每个成员所能区分的每一对（见定义 2），因此一个集合可以比其中每一个成员都更锐利，每个成员都提供其他成员所缺乏的区分能力。 因此，通往更锐利工具的路径既可以经由更好的个体评判者，也可以经由辨别力的多样性。 第二点是不会有任何警告发出。 根据推论 11，通过只说明被考者位于评估器之上某处，因此一个对该任务而言过于粗糙的评估器给出的通过，看起来与一个合格评估器给出的通过毫无二致。 第三点是通常的工具对此无能为力：更难的题目和更丰富的支架只是压向被考者，对于正在做读取的工具能区分什么毫无改变。

paragraphs.en: Emulation from above and detection from below both concern an evaluator reading behaviour: emulation requires the examinee to choose what the evaluator sees, and detection requires a reply the evaluator can perceive. The part of Corollary 11 that needs no strategy on the examinee’s side, item 2, carries to an observer of any kind: an observation within a cell is consistent with everything in it. § 4.3 uses this for interpretability probes.

paragraphs.en: A framing (Sections 2 and 3 ): the evaluator, not only the examinee, has a discrimination structure, and what it can certify is bounded by it (Lemma 4 ). An evaluation compares two such structures, which gives a one-sided bound: an examinee sharper than its evaluator can present as a peer, while one that is coarser cannot conceal the fact from exhaustive probing. The bound holds for tests the evaluator can grade under the conditions of Theorems 7 and 9 ; the echo test is complete for such tests (Proposition 10 ); a coarse evaluator errs against honest weakness (Corollary 12 ); and a worked example instantiates it (Appendix A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个框架（第2节和第3节）：不仅被评测者，评测者自身也具有一个判别结构，而它所能认证的范围受该结构限定（引理4）。 一次评测比较的是两个这样的结构，由此给出一个单侧界：比其评测者更精细的被评测者可以伪装成同侪，而更粗糙的被评测者无法在穷尽式探测下隐瞒这一事实。 该界对评测者在定理7和定理9的条件下能够评分的测试成立；回声测试对这类测试是完全的（命题10）；粗糙的评测者会误判诚实的弱项（推论12）；并且一个具体算例将其实例化（附录A.2）。

paragraphs.en: Six consequences (Section 4 ), arranged on a 2 × 3 2\times 3 grid of who assesses whom against adversariality. Exact sandbagging is undetectable by any behavioural evaluator. An interpretability probe cannot prove absence where it merges representations. An added monitor increases collective discrimination exactly when it separates a pair the ensemble does not. A channel the examinee controls can hide, from an evaluator that checks consistency over undisturbed channels, only what every other channel misses. No discrimination ceiling is self-assessed, and adversarial self-report adds nothing to testing. Corollary 13 limits these results to discrimination, which is necessary for task competence but not sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 六项推论（第4节），按“谁评估谁”与对抗性排列在一个 2 × 3 2\times 3 的网格中。 精确的沙袋行为（sandbagging）对任何行为评估器而言都是不可检测的。 当可解释性探针将表征合并时，它无法证明某种性质不存在。 新增的监控器恰好在它能区分整体无法区分的某一对时，才增加集体区分能力。 对于检查未被扰动信道一致性的评估器而言，被试者控制的信道所能隐藏的，只是所有其他信道都遗漏的内容。 不存在自我评估的区分上限，且对抗性自我报告对测试毫无增益。 推论13将上述结果限定于区分能力，它是任务胜任能力的必要条件但非充分条件。

paragraphs.en: Empirical implications (Section 5 ). Four published findings read through the model: judges disagree, weight noise exposes sandbagging, elicitation recovers locked capability, and monitor-aware models sometimes evade chain-of-thought monitors. Three predictions follow. For concealment that the examinee’s elicitation leaves in place, eliciting the examinee should not raise detection, while sharpening the evaluator can. Under weight noise a concealing model returns to its unconcealed replies, with a rise that shrinks as the task needs more layers of processing. Encodings shaped against a monitor, over inputs that vary enough to isolate each output, approach renamings within the level sets of its score.
paragraphs.zh: 实证意涵（第 5 节）。 通过该模型解读四项已发表的研究结果：评委意见不一致、权重噪声暴露沙袋行为、引导可恢复被锁定的能力，以及具备监控意识的模型有时能规避思维链监控器。 由此得出三个预测。 对于应试者的引导未能消除的隐蔽行为，引导应试者不应提升检出率，而锐化评估者则可以。 在权重噪声作用下，隐蔽模型会回归其未隐蔽的回答，且任务所需的处理层数越多，这一回升幅度越小。 针对监控器塑造的编码，在输入变化足以隔离每个输出的情况下，会趋近于其得分水平集内的重命名。

paragraphs.en: The join Π 1 ∨ Π 2 \Pi_{1}\vee\Pi_{2} of two partitions is the coarsest partition refining both: two stimuli share a cell of the join exactly when they share a cell of each. Under ⪯ \preceq , which puts finer partitions lower, the same partition is the meet.

paragraphs.en: A partition can be read as a grid ruled over Σ \Sigma : the agent sees which cell a stimulus falls into, and nothing finer. Refinement is a grid with more lines, and the join of two grids is their overlay. Figure 1 renders the results of Sections 3 and 4 this way.
paragraphs.zh: 一个划分可以看作是画在 Σ \Sigma 上的一张网格：智能体只能看到刺激落入哪个格子，而看不到更细的信息。 加细就是画上更多线条的网格，而两个网格的并（join）就是它们的叠加。 图 1 以这种方式呈现了第 3 节和第 4 节的结果。

sents.zh: 加细就是画上更多线条的网格，而两个网格的并（join）就是它们的叠加。

sents.en: Figure 1 renders the results of Sections 3 and 4 this way.
sents.zh: 图 1 以这种方式呈现了第 3 节和第 4 节的结果。

paragraphs.en: The grid picture can obscure two properties of partitions. Not every partition is a grid; cells may take any shape. And refinement is a partial order rather than a total one, so two partitions need not be comparable: a cell of one may straddle a boundary of the other, each separating what the other runs together. Nested grids are therefore not guaranteed, and we expect them to be the exception rather than the rule. The theorems split on whether Π B \Pi_{B} refines Π A \Pi_{A} , and the incomparable case falls on the side where it does not.
paragraphs.zh: 网格图景可能掩盖划分的两个性质。 并非每个划分都是网格；单元格可以呈任意形状。 而且加细是一种偏序而非全序，因此两个划分未必可比：其中一个划分的单元格可能横跨另一个划分的边界，各自把对方混在一起的东西分离开来。 因此嵌套网格并不总能得到，我们预期它们是例外而非通例。 这些定理取决于 Π B \Pi_{B} 是否加细 Π A \Pi_{A}，不可比的情形落在不加细的一侧。

paragraphs.en: Agents are A , B , C , … A,B,C,\dots . A letter names an agent rather than a place in a protocol: in the statements, A A is the evaluator and B B the examinee, whether the setting is the echo test of Definition 6 , the interpretability probe of § 4.3 or the language model judge of a scalable-oversight pipeline. A proof that applies a result with another agent in A A ’s role says so. For an agent Z Z we write P Z P_{Z} for its perception, E Z E_{Z} for its emission, β Z = E Z ∘ P Z \beta_{Z}=E_{Z}\circ P_{Z} for its behaviour and Π Z \Pi_{Z} for its discrimination partition; a peer of A A is an agent whose partition is Π A \Pi_{A} . Lowercase indices Π i , Π j \Pi_{i},\Pi_{j} denote observers or channels rather than named agents. One symbol stands outside this scheme: J J , a percept-reading evaluator that observes percepts directly rather than behaviour, which appears only where we contrast the two kinds of access (Figure 5 , Appendix A ). Table 2 in Appendix E collects the symbols.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体为 A , B , C , … A,B,C,\dots 。 一个字母指称一个智能体，而非协议中的某个位置：在各项陈述中，A A 是评估者，B B 是受试者，无论场景是定义 6 的回声测试、§4.3 的可解释性探针，还是可扩展监督流水线中的语言模型裁判。 若某个证明将结论应用于在 A A 角色中的另一个智能体，则会予以说明。 对于智能体 Z Z，我们用 P Z P_{Z} 表示其感知，用 E Z E_{Z} 表示其发出，用 β Z = E Z ∘ P Z \beta_{Z}=E_{Z}\circ P_{Z} 表示其行为，用 Π Z \Pi_{Z} 表示其判别划分；A A 的同侪是其划分为 Π A \Pi_{A} 的智能体。 小写下标 Π i , Π j \Pi_{i},\Pi_{j} 表示观察者或信道，而非具名的智能体。 有一个符号处于此方案之外：J J，一个读取知觉的评估者，它直接观察知觉而非行为，仅在我们对比这两类访问方式时出现（图 5，附录 A）。 附录 E 中的表 2 汇总了这些符号。

paragraphs.en: In a neural network the partition has a mechanism behind it. A network represents more features than it has dimensions by storing them in overlapping directions and tolerating the interference, a regime known as superposition ( Elhage et al., 2022 ) . Capacity is finite and features compete for it, so a model separates what it has room to separate. Features it drops from a representation are run together there exactly, which is a partition, unless another route, such as copying, carries them; features stored in superposition are separated only up to interference, a graded case Section 7 returns to.
paragraphs.zh: 在神经网络中，这种划分背后有一种机制。 网络通过将特征存储在相互重叠的方向上并容忍由此产生的干扰，来表示多于其维度数量的特征，这种状态被称为叠加（Elhage et al., 2022）。 容量是有限的，特征会争夺容量，因此模型只会分离它有空间分离的那些特征。 模型从某个表示中舍弃的特征会恰好在该表示中被混在一起，这就构成一种划分，除非存在另一条路径（例如复制）来携带它们；而以叠加方式存储的特征只能在被干扰所限制的范围内被分离，这是一种渐变的情况，第 7 节将回到这一点。

sents.en: In a neural network the partition has a mechanism behind it.
sents.zh: 在神经网络中，这种划分背后有一种机制。

paragraphs.en: On this view a partition is fixed by construction, and what counts as a change of partition depends on where the boundary of the agent is drawn. For a language model there are two natural boundaries. Take the agent to be the bare model, and Π A \Pi_{A} is a property of its weights. A prompt, a scaffold or a returned tool result is then a further input rather than a modification of the thing receiving it, so it changes the stimulus and not the partition, while fine-tuning changes the weights and so yields a different agent. Take the agent to be the deployed system, meaning the model together with its prompt template, scaffold, tools and decoding procedure, and Π A \Pi_{A} is a property of that whole system; changing any of these yields a different system, which may differ in its partition, its emission or both. Which boundary to use for each party is the study’s choice; the theory compares any two partitions of the same stimuli, wherever their boundaries are drawn. Assumption 26 (Section 5 ) is accordingly a claim about the configurations an elicitation budget produces, not a claim that perception itself improves.
paragraphs.zh: 在这种观点下，划分由构造固定下来，而什么算作划分的改变则取决于智能体的边界画在哪里。 对于语言模型，存在两种自然的边界。 把智能体视为裸模型，则 Π A \Pi_{A} 是其权重的一个属性。 提示词、脚手架或返回的工具结果就是进一步的输入，而非对接收者本身的修改，因此它改变的是刺激而不是划分；而微调改变权重，从而产生一个不同的智能体。 把智能体视为部署的系统，即模型连同其提示词模板、脚手架、工具和解码过程，则 Π A \Pi_{A} 是整个系统的属性；改变其中任何一项都会得到一个不同的系统，该系统可能在划分、发出或两者上有所不同。 对每一方采用哪种边界是本研究的选择；该理论比较的是同一刺激的任意两个划分，无论其边界画在哪里。 因此，假设 26（第 5 节）是关于引导预算所产生的配置的论断，而不是关于知觉本身会改善的论断。

paragraphs.en: We do not model the medium, meaning anything that acts on a stimulus between the two agents and is controlled by neither, whether deterministic or random. A reply is taken to arrive unchanged. This matters for the echo test, in which A A reads B B ’s reply as a stimulus (Definition 6 ). A study that needs a medium can add it as a further map on stimuli between the two agents; this paper does not.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不对媒介建模，即任何在两个智能体之间作用于刺激且不受二者控制的东西，无论其是确定性的还是随机的。 回复被视为原样到达。 这对回声测试很重要，在该测试中，A 将 B 的回复读取为一个刺激（定义 6）。 需要媒介的研究可以将其作为施加于两个智能体之间刺激的一个附加映射加入进来；本文不作此处理。

paragraphs.en: An agent’s behaviour depends on the stimulus only through its percept: the total behaviour map β A : Σ → 𝒜 \beta_{A}:\Sigma\to\mathcal{A} factors as β A = E A ∘ P A \beta_{A}=E_{A}\circ P_{A} .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的行为仅通过其感知依赖于刺激：总行为映射 β A : Σ → 𝒜 \beta_{A}:\Sigma\to\mathcal{A} 可分解为 β A = E A ∘ P A \beta_{A}=E_{A}\circ P_{A}。

paragraphs.en: Axiom 3 makes perception the single map behind everything an agent does: elicitation can change the percept or how it becomes a reply, but every reply is computed from the percept. The axiom does not say how perception and emission are implemented. In a language model, for instance, the same weights may serve both, and decoding, which acts after the forward pass, belongs to emission: greedy decoding gives a map, and sampling brings in the seed discussed below. Every route by which the stimulus reaches the reply counts toward the partition, including verbatim copying and lookup in a fixed cache or retrieval index (a cache written between probes is state, which the axiom excludes). A system that can return an input verbatim separates that input from every other, so its partition is fine whatever it understands. Such a partition says nothing about competence, since discrimination is necessary for competence and not sufficient (Corollary 13 ). The results take an agent’s emission to range over all maps from its percepts to actions: that B B can realise a behaviour means some emission gives it, and whether B B can compute that emission is a further capability the model does not represent. Section 7 returns to this.
paragraphs.zh: 公理3使感知成为智能体一切行为背后的唯一映射：引导可以改变感知内容或其成为回复的方式，但每个回复都是从感知内容计算出来的。 该公理并未说明感知与发出是如何实现的。 例如在语言模型中，同一组权重可能同时服务于二者，而作用于前向传播之后的解码属于发出：贪心解码给出一个映射，而采样则引入下文讨论的随机种子。 刺激到达回复所经的每条路径都计入该划分，包括逐字复制以及在固定缓存或检索索引中的查找（在探测之间写入的缓存属于状态，是公理所排除的）。 一个能够逐字返回某个输入的系统，就把该输入与其他一切输入区分开来，因此无论它理解什么，其划分都是细粒度的。 这样的划分对能力毫无说明，因为区分是能力的必要条件而非充分条件（推论13）。 这些结果将智能体的发出视为取遍其从感知内容到动作的所有映射：B 能够实现某个行为，意味着某个发出给出了它，而 B 能否计算该发出则是模型并不表示的又一种能力。 第7节将回到这一点。

sents.zh: 一个能够逐字返回某个输入的系统，就把该输入与其他一切输入区分开来，因此无论它理解什么，其划分都是细粒度的。

sents.en: Such a partition says nothing about competence, since discrimination is necessary for competence and not sufficient (Corollary 13 ).
sents.zh: 这样的划分对能力毫无说明，因为区分是能力的必要条件而非充分条件（推论13）。

sents.en: The results take an agent’s emission to range over all maps from its percepts to actions: that B B can realise a behaviour means some emission gives it, and whether B B can compute that emission is a further capability the model does not represent.
sents.zh: 这些结果将智能体的发出视为取遍其从感知内容到动作的所有映射：B 能够实现某个行为，意味着某个发出给出了它，而 B 能否计算该发出则是模型并不表示的又一种能力。

sents.en: Section 7 returns to this.

paragraphs.en: A verdict, a self-report and a monitor’s flag are all computed from percepts, so each is bounded in this way.
paragraphs.zh: 裁决、自我报告和监控器的标记都是从感知计算得出的，因此每一个都以这种方式受到限制。

paragraphs.en: A behaviour β : Σ → 𝒜 \beta:\Sigma\to\mathcal{A} factors through a perception map P : Σ → X P:\Sigma\to X when there is an emission map E : X → 𝒜 E:X\to\mathcal{A} with β = E ∘ P \beta=E\circ P ; equivalently, β \beta is constant on the cells of the partition P P induces, so it separates no pair that P P conflates. Axiom 3 says every agent’s behaviour factors through its own perception map. Theorem 7 concerns behaviour that factors through another agent’s.
paragraphs.zh: 行为 β : Σ → 𝒜 \beta:\Sigma\to\mathcal{A} 通过感知映射 P : Σ → X P:\Sigma\to X 分解，当存在发射映射 E : X → 𝒜 E:X\to\mathcal{A} 使得 β = E ∘ P \beta=E\circ P；等价地，β \beta 在 P P 诱导的划分的各个单元上为常值，因此它不区分任何被 P P 混同的对。 公理 3 说明每个智能体的行为都通过其自身的感知映射分解。 定理 7 关注通过另一智能体的感知映射分解的行为。

sents.en: A behaviour β : Σ → 𝒜 \beta:\Sigma\to\mathcal{A} factors through a perception map P : Σ → X P:\Sigma\to X when there is an emission map E : X → 𝒜 E:X\to\mathcal{A} with β = E ∘ P \beta=E\circ P ; equivalently, β \beta is constant on the cells of the partition P P induces, so it separates no pair that P P conflates.
sents.zh: 行为 β : Σ → 𝒜 \beta:\Sigma\to\mathcal{A} 通过感知映射 P : Σ → X P:\Sigma\to X 分解，当存在发射映射 E : X → 𝒜 E:X\to\mathcal{A} 使得 β = E ∘ P \beta=E\circ P；等价地，β \beta 在 P P 诱导的划分的各个单元上为常值，因此它不区分任何被 P P 混同的对。

sents.en: Axiom 3 says every agent’s behaviour factors through its own perception map.
sents.zh: 公理 3 说明每个智能体的行为都通过其自身的感知映射分解。

sents.en: Theorem 7 concerns behaviour that factors through another agent’s.
sents.zh: 定理 7 关注通过另一智能体的感知映射分解的行为。

paragraphs.en: The axiom says two things. First, behaviour is a function of the stimulus: the same stimulus always gets the same reply, so no state is carried from one probe to the next. Second, that function passes through the percept: it factors through P A P_{A} . Determinism therefore follows from the first part and need not be assumed separately. An agent whose reply varies while its percept stays fixed must be reading something besides that percept. It may be state, which the axiom excludes. Or it may be a random seed, such as the one a sampler draws to pick each reply. A seed is an input, so we count it as part of the stimulus: two probes with different seeds are then different stimuli, and β A \beta_{A} is again a function, on a stimulus set enlarged to include seeds. For a language model with greedy decoding there is no seed, and the stimulus set needs no enlarging.
paragraphs.zh: 该公理说了两件事。 其一，行为是刺激的函数：相同的刺激总是得到相同的回应，因此状态不会从一个探测携带到下一个探测。 其二，该函数经过感知：它可以分解为经过 P A P_{A} 的复合。 因此，确定性由第一部分推出，无需单独假设。 若某个智能体在感知保持不变的情况下回应却发生变化，那么它必然在读取该感知之外的东西。 它可能是状态，而公理排除了状态。 或者它可能是一个随机种子，比如采样器为选择每个回应而抽取的种子。 种子是一种输入，所以我们把它算作刺激的一部分：这样，两个种子不同的探测就是不同的刺激，而 β A \beta_{A} 依然是一个函数，只是定义在扩大到包含种子的刺激集上。 对于采用贪心解码的语言模型来说，不存在种子，刺激集也无需扩大。

paragraphs.en: A test 𝒯 = ( S , G ) \mathcal{T}=(S,G) consists of a set S ⊆ Σ S\subseteq\Sigma of test cases and an acceptance rule G G that assigns to each s ∈ S s\in S a set G ⁡ ( s ) ⊆ 𝒜 G(s)\subseteq\mathcal{A} of acceptable replies.
paragraphs.zh: 一个测试 𝒯 = ( S , G ) \mathcal{T}=(S,G) 由一个测试用例集合 S ⊆ Σ S\subseteq\Sigma 和一个接受规则 G G 组成，该规则为每个 s ∈ S s\in S 指定一个可接受回复的集合 G ⁡ ( s ) ⊆ 𝒜 G(s)\subseteq\mathcal{A} 。

paragraphs.en: B B passes 𝒯 \mathcal{T} at s ∈ S s\in S when β B ​ ( s ) ∈ G ​ ( s ) \beta_{B}(s)\in G(s) .
paragraphs.zh: 当 β B ​ ( s ) ∈ G ​ ( s ) \beta_{B}(s)\in G(s) 时，B B 在 s ∈ S s\in S 处通过 𝒯 \mathcal{T}。

paragraphs.en: An evaluator administers 𝒯 \mathcal{T} by probing a set Q ⊆ S Q\subseteq S of its cases; each presentation of a case is a probe , and a case may be probed more than once. The evaluator probes exhaustively when Q = S Q=S . B B passes 𝒯 \mathcal{T} on Q Q when it passes at every s ∈ Q s\in Q .
paragraphs.zh: 评估者通过探测一组用例 Q ⊆ S Q\subseteq S 来实施 𝒯 \mathcal{T}；每次呈现一个用例即为一次探测，且同一用例可被探测多次。 当 Q = S Q=S 时，评估者进行穷尽探测。 当 B B 在每个 s ∈ Q s\in Q 上都通过时，称 B B 在 Q Q 上通过 𝒯 \mathcal{T}。

paragraphs.en: 𝒯 \mathcal{T} is gradable by an evaluator A A when its acceptance rule factors through A A ’s perception: for s , s ′ ∈ S s,s^{\prime}\in S , s ≡ A s ′ s\equiv_{A}s^{\prime} implies G ⁡ ( s ) = G ⁡ ( s ′ ) G(s)=G(s^{\prime}) . 𝒯 \mathcal{T} is graded by A A when A A is the evaluator that administers it.
paragraphs.zh: 当 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 的接受规则可通过 A A 的感知分解时，称 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 可被评估者 A A 评级：对于 s , s ′ ∈ S s,s^{\prime}\in S ， s ≡ A s ′ s\equiv_{A}s^{\prime} 蕴含 G ⁡ ( s ) = G ⁡ ( s ′ ) G(s)=G(s^{\prime}) 。当 A A 是执行该评级任务的评估者时，称 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 由 A A 评级。

paragraphs.en: A task is a test whose acceptable replies are the correct responses.
paragraphs.zh: 任务是一种测试，其可接受的回复即为正确答案。

paragraphs.en: A test fixes its cases and its rule, whoever supplies them. A claim about all of Σ \Sigma needs S = Σ S=\Sigma ; a claim about a narrower scope takes that scope as S S . A test gradable by A A is one whose acceptable replies are fixed by what A A perceives of each case. A benchmark scored by a judge against reference answers is graded by that judge, and gradable by it when the judge tells apart any two items whose reference answers differ. A task need not be gradable by A A . When A A grades a test by perceiving each case and each reply separately, its verdicts depend only on those percepts (Lemma 4 ), so it applies some rule gradable by A A . If the test is not gradable by A A , that rule differs from the test’s own at one of two cases A A conflates, and there A A accepts or rejects some reply wrongly.
paragraphs.zh: 一个测试固定了它的用例和它的规则，无论这些由谁提供。 关于整个 Σ \Sigma 的断言需要 S = Σ S=\Sigma ；关于更小范围的断言则将该范围取为 S S 。 一个可由 A A 评定的测试，是指其可接受的回答由 A A 对每个用例所感知到的内容所固定。 一个由裁判对照参考答案打分的基准测试，是由该裁判评定的；当该裁判能区分任何两个参考答案不同的条目时，它就是可由该裁判评定的。 一个任务不必可由 A A 评定。 当 A A 通过分别感知每个用例和每个回答来评定一个测试时，它的判定只取决于这些感知（引理 4 ），因此它应用的是某个可由 A A 评定的规则。 如果该测试不可由 A A 评定，那么该规则在 A A 混同的两个用例之一处与测试自身的规则不同，而在那里 A A 会错误地接受或拒绝某个回答。

Each holds for a narrower scope S S with the cases restricted to S S and every partition restricted to S S , that is, replaced by the partition of S S into the non-empty intersections of its cells with S S . paragraphs.en: A system that can copy its input passes the echo test trivially. Copying separates every input, so the copier’s partition is fine, and its pass certifies that discrimination and nothing about competence (Corollary 13 ). A test meant to measure competence rather than discrimination can ask for a paraphrase instead.

paragraphs.en: The echo test asks only whether B B can return what A A said, as judged by A A , so A A ’s partition is the only standard in play. It does not ask B B to return s s itself, only a reply in the same A A -cell. In the echo test, every two stimuli A A separates have disjoint sets of acceptable replies.
paragraphs.zh: 回声测试只问 B B 能否返回 A A 所说的内容，且由 A A 来判定，因此 A A 的划分是唯一使用的标准。 它并不要求 B B 返回 s s 本身，只要求返回一个位于同一 A A 单元格内的回应。 在回声测试中，A A 所区分的任意两个刺激，其可接受回应的集合互不相交。

paragraphs.en: Two facts, pointing opposite ways. An examinee at least as sharp as its evaluator can reproduce whatever that evaluator expects. One that is coarser cannot hide the fact from an evaluator that probes a pair it conflates. These are emulation from above and detection from below, named after the examinee’s place relative to its evaluator. Both follow from Lemma 4 , and together they give the one-sided bound. They hold for tests the evaluator can grade, under conditions on the acceptable replies.
paragraphs.zh: 两个事实，指向相反的方向。 一个至少与其评估者同样敏锐的智能体，可以复现该评估者所期望的任何内容。 一个较为粗略的智能体，无法对探测其所混淆的一对内容的评估者隐瞒这一事实。 这就是自上而下的仿真与自下而上的检测，其命名依据是智能体相对于其评估者的位置。 两者都由引理 4 推出，并且它们共同给出了单侧界。 对于评估者能够评分的测试，它们在可接受回答的条件下成立。

sents.zh: 两个事实，指向相反的方向。

sents.en: An examinee at least as sharp as its evaluator can reproduce whatever that evaluator expects.

sents.en: They hold for tests the evaluator can grade, under conditions on the acceptable replies.
sents.zh: 对于评估者能够评分的测试，它们在可接受回答的条件下成立。

paragraphs.en: B B can realise the behaviour of any agent whose behaviour depends on the stimulus only through P A P_{A} , and is then accepted by every test exactly where that agent is.
paragraphs.zh: B B 可以实现任何行为仅通过 P A P_{A} 依赖于刺激的智能体的行为，并且在每个测试中被接受的位置恰好与该智能体相同。

paragraphs.en: B B can pass, at every stimulus, any test gradable by A A in which every set of acceptable replies is non-empty. In particular, if every A A -cell contains an action, B B can pass the echo test at every stimulus and be behaviourally indistinguishable from a peer of A A .
paragraphs.zh: 若每个可接受回应的集合都非空，则 B 在每个刺激下都能通过 A 可评级的任何测试。 特别地，若每个 A 单元都包含一个动作，则 B 在每个刺激下都能通过回声测试，并在行为上与 A 的同伴无法区分。

paragraphs.en: The proof builds the emulator from two maps. Since every B B -cell lies inside one A A -cell, B B can tell which A A -cell an input is in; the coarsening map h h does this, turning B B ’s percept into A A ’s. If every A A -cell contains an action, the prototype selector ρ \rho picks one action in each A A -cell. With E B = ρ ∘ h E_{B}=\rho\circ h , B B answers each input with an action from that input’s A A -cell, which A A cannot tell from the input itself. The proof is in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 该证明通过两个映射构造模拟器。 由于每个 B 细胞都位于某个 A 细胞之内，B 能判断输入属于哪个 A 细胞；粗化映射 h 正是完成这一点，把 B 的感知转换为 A 的感知。 若每个 A 细胞中都包含一个动作，原型选择器 ρ 会在每个 A 细胞中挑选一个动作。 取 E_B = ρ∘h，B 对每个输入的回应都是来自该输入所在 A 细胞的动作，而 A 无法凭输入本身将其与原输入区分开。 该证明见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 7 says such an emission exists, not that it is easy to find or compute: in item 1, B B ’s emission must compute the target’s whole emission E E together with the coarsening h h . Whether B B can compute that emission is a further capability, which the model does not represent. Remark 8 names one part of it.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 7 说明这样的发射是存在的，并不意味着它容易找到或计算：在第 1 项中，B 的发射必须同时计算目标对象的整体发射 E 以及粗化映射 h。 B 能否计算该发射是另一项能力，而该模型并未对这一能力进行表示。 注记 8 指出了其中的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 7 makes emulation possible. To emulate a particular target, B B must also know how that target behaves, as A A perceives it. If B B misjudges its target, it is not thereby exposed: it simply behaves differently from the target. No behaviour is evidence of concealment on its own. Any behaviour β B \beta_{B} is exactly that of an agent that conceals nothing, namely the agent whose percept is β B \beta_{B} itself and whose emission is the identity. Behaviour reveals concealment only relative to an assumption about what honest agents look like, for example that an honest weak model makes certain mistakes. Without such an assumption, an emulator that misjudges its target looks like some other honest agent.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 7 使模仿成为可能。 要模仿某个特定目标，B 也必须知道该目标在 A 看来是如何表现的。 如果 B 误判了它的目标，它并不会因此暴露：它只是表现得与目标不同而已。 任何行为本身都不构成隐藏的证据。 任何行为 β_B 都恰好是一个毫无隐藏的智能体的行为，即感知为 β_B 本身且发出为恒等映射的智能体。 行为只有在关于诚实智能体是什么样的假设下才能揭示隐藏，例如假设一个诚实的弱模型会犯某些错误。 没有这种假设，一个误判其目标的模仿者看起来就像另一个诚实的智能体。

sents.en: Theorem 7 makes emulation possible.
sents.zh: 定理 7 使模仿成为可能。

If both are probed, B B fails at one of them. In particular, if Π B ⋠ Π A \Pi_{B}\not\preceq\Pi_{A} , then B B fails the echo test on some probed stimulus, provided A A probes both members of a pair B B conflates and A A separates.

For the echo test, stimuli in different A A -cells have disjoint sets of acceptable replies, and Π B ⋠ Π A \Pi_{B}\not\preceq\Pi_{A} gives a pair with s 1 ≡ B s 2 s_{1}\equiv_{B}s_{2} and s 1 ≢ A s 2 s_{1}\not\equiv_{A}s_{2} . ∎

sents.zh: 由引理 4，β B ​ ( s 1 ) = β B ​ ( s 2 ) \beta_{B}(s_{1})=\beta_{B}(s_{2})，且每个回复至多属于两个不相交集合中的一个。

paragraphs.en: Here “below” means below at some pair: B B may draw distinctions A A lacks elsewhere, and is still caught where it falls short. What is detected is that shortfall, a distinction A A draws that B B lacks, not concealment. The test need not be gradable by A A for B B to fail: that needs only a conflated pair whose sets of acceptable replies do not overlap. A A records the failure wherever its verdict agrees with the test’s rule, as in the echo test, whose rule A A applies exactly. Of the tests gradable by A A , the echo test is complete.
paragraphs.zh: 这里「在下」指的是在某一对组合中处于下位：B B 可能在别处能作出 A A 所没有的区分，但仍然会在其不足之处被识破。 所检测到的正是这种不足，即 A A 能作出而 B B 缺少的某个区分，而非隐瞒。 即便该测试无法由 A A 来评分，B B 也可能失败：这只需要一对被混同的组合，其可接受回答的集合互不重叠。 只要 A A 的判定与测试规则一致，A A 就会记录失败，例如回声测试，其规则 A A 能完全准确地执行。 在 A A 能够评分的测试中，回声测试是完备的。

sents.en: Here “below” means below at some pair: B B may draw distinctions A A lacks elsewhere, and is still caught where it falls short.
sents.zh: 这里「在下」指的是在某一对组合中处于下位：B B 可能在别处能作出 A A 所没有的区分，但仍然会在其不足之处被识破。

sents.zh: 所检测到的正是这种不足，即 A A 能作出而 B B 缺少的某个区分，而非隐瞒。

sents.en: A A records the failure wherever its verdict agrees with the test’s rule, as in the echo test, whose rule A A applies exactly.

sents.en: Of the tests gradable by A A , the echo test is complete.
sents.zh: 在 A A 能够评分的测试中，回声测试是完备的。

paragraphs.en: Let every A A -cell contain an action. Then B B can pass the echo test of A A at every stimulus if and only if Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A} , and if Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A} then B B can pass every test gradable by A A whose sets of acceptable replies are non-empty. A pass on such a test therefore certifies nothing about Π B \Pi_{B} that a pass on the echo test does not.
paragraphs.zh: 令每个 A A-格都包含一个动作。 那么 B B 能在每个刺激下通过 A A 的回声测试，当且仅当 Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A}；并且若 Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A}，则 B B 能通过 A A 可评定的、其可接受回应集合非空的每一个测试。 因此，通过这样一个测试所证明的关于 Π B \Pi_{B} 的信息，不会超过通过回声测试所证明的。

sents.en: Let every A A -cell contain an action.
sents.zh: 令每个 A A-格都包含一个动作。

sents.en: Then B B can pass the echo test of A A at every stimulus if and only if Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A} , and if Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A} then B B can pass every test gradable by A A whose sets of acceptable replies are non-empty.
sents.zh: 那么 B B 能在每个刺激下通过 A A 的回声测试，当且仅当 Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A}；并且若 Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A}，则 B B 能通过 A A 可评定的、其可接受回应集合非空的每一个测试。

sents.en: A pass on such a test therefore certifies nothing about Π B \Pi_{B} that a pass on the echo test does not.
sents.zh: 因此，通过这样一个测试所证明的关于 Π B \Pi_{B} 的信息，不会超过通过回声测试所证明的。

paragraphs.en: In this sense the echo test is complete for the tests gradable by A A , much as a complete problem stands for its complexity class. Here an examinee can pass a test when some emission of it passes. Whether the examinee can compute that emission, for instance the correct answer to each item, is a further capability. An examinee that copies its input passes the echo test without being competent at any task (Corollary 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在此意义上，回声测试对于可由 A A 评级的测试是完备的，正如一个完全问题代表其复杂性类一样。 在这里，当一个应试者的某次输出通过测试时，该应试者即可通过测试。 至于该应试者能否计算出该输出，例如每道题目的正确答案，则是另一项能力。 一个复制其输入的应试者可以通过回声测试，却并不具备完成任何任务的能力（推论 13）。

sents.en: In this sense the echo test is complete for the tests gradable by A A , much as a complete problem stands for its complexity class.
sents.zh: 在此意义上，回声测试对于可由 A A 评级的测试是完备的，正如一个完全问题代表其复杂性类一样。

sents.zh: 在这里，当一个应试者的某次输出通过测试时，该应试者即可通过测试。

paragraphs.en: Item 1 needs cooperativeness because a sharper examinee may still fail. Theorem 7 says that a sharper B B can pass, not that it must. An examinee that refines Π A \Pi_{A} but declines to pass will fail, and § 4.2 depends on this case. An examinee that tries to pass but judges Π A \Pi_{A} coarser than it is may also fail. Failure also does not mean that B B is coarser than A A overall. The condition Π B ⋠ Π A \Pi_{B}\not\preceq\Pi_{A} holds equally when the two partitions are incomparable, with each drawing distinctions the other cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 条目 1 需要合作性，因为一个更敏锐的考生仍可能不及格。 定理 7 说的是更敏锐的 B B 可以通过，而不是它必须通过。 一个精化了 Π A \Pi_{A} 但拒绝通过的考生会不及格，而 § 4.2 正依赖于这一情形。 一个试图通过但把 Π A \Pi_{A} 判断得比实际更粗的考生也可能不及格。 不及格也不意味着 B B 整体上比 A A 更粗。 当两个划分不可比时，条件 Π B ⋠ Π A \Pi_{B}\not\preceq\Pi_{A} 同样成立，即各自都能作出对方无法作出的区分。

paragraphs.en: The two halves transfer differently. Detection needs a test that gives a conflated pair disjoint sets of acceptable replies (Theorem 9 ), administered by an evaluator whose verdicts there agree with the test’s rule. Indistinguishability rests on exact emulation. The second half of Corollary 11 , item 2, holds because a strictly finer examinee can emulate a peer exactly (Theorem 7 ), and identical behaviour gives identical observations under any protocol, adaptive, randomised or multi-round included (Corollary 17 , item 1). Inexact emulation under such protocols, and stateful agents, lie outside these results. Within this scope, behavioural evaluation yields lower bounds on discrimination, and no upper bound beyond the conflated pairs that a cooperative examinee’s failures expose.

paragraphs.en: A detector that flags concealment whenever the examinee fails the echo test therefore fires on B h B_{\mathrm{h}} and never on B c B_{\mathrm{c}} . Against these two arms it does worse than chance: its flags run opposite to the property it is meant to detect. This is a specificity control, which tests of a concealment detector need. Concealers less exact than B c B_{\mathrm{c}} , which misjudge Π A \Pi_{A} (Remark 8 ), will sometimes fail, so a detector scored only on concealing examinees can show a respectable true-positive rate. The same detector flags every honestly weak examinee, because under exhaustive probing each one fails. It is detecting apparent weakness, and it catches a concealer only when that concealer happens to look weak. An honestly weak arm, matched to the level the concealers present, exposes this: it measures how often honest examinees are flagged as concealing. The direction of the error follows from Theorems 7 and 9 ; its size depends on how densely A A probes, since under sparse probing the pair an honestly weak examinee conflates may go unprobed.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，每当考生未通过回声测试时便会触发隐藏标记的检测器，会在 B h B_{\mathrm{h}} 上触发，而从不在 B c B_{\mathrm{c}} 上触发。 对于这两个选项，它的表现不如随机猜测：它给出的标记与其想要检测的属性正好相反。 这是一个特异性控制，隐藏检测器的测试需要这种控制。 不如 B c B_{\mathrm{c}} 精确的隐藏者（即误判 Π A \Pi_{A} 的隐藏者，见注 8）有时会失败，因此仅在隐藏型考生上评分的检测器可以展现出相当不错的真阳性率。 同一个检测器会标记每一个真正能力弱的考生，因为在穷尽式探测下，每个这样的考生都会失败。 它检测的是表面上的弱点，只有当隐藏者恰好看起来弱时，它才会抓住隐藏者。 一个与隐藏者所呈现水平相匹配的、真正能力弱的选项可以揭示这一点：它衡量的是真正能力弱的考生被标记为隐藏的频率。 错误的方向可由定理 7 和定理 9 推出；其大小取决于 A A 探测的密集程度，因为在稀疏探测下，真正能力弱的考生所混淆的那对选项可能未被探测到。

paragraphs.en: The converse fails. Separating s 1 s_{1} from s 2 s_{2} does not entail answering either correctly: discrimination is a substrate for competence, not a form of it. Consequently our results transfer to capability evaluation in exactly one direction. Coarseness implies incompetence, so a model too coarse for a task cannot hide that fact from a test that includes both items (Corollary 13 ). The reverse inference fails, since a model with sufficient discrimination may decline to use it (Theorem 7 ). Whether fine discrimination predicts task performance is a separate question. The claims below are bounds on discrimination and on what discrimination makes possible, not a reduction of capability to partition structure.
paragraphs.zh: 反之不成立。 将 s 1 s_{1} 与 s 2 s_{2} 区分开并不意味着能正确回答其中任何一个：区分能力是能力的基础，而非能力的一种形式。 因此，我们的结果仅以恰好一个方向迁移到能力评估中。 粗粒度意味着无能，因此对一个任务而言过于粗糙的模型，无法在包含两类条目的测试中掩盖这一事实（推论 13）。 反向推断不成立，因为具有足够区分能力的模型可能拒绝使用它（定理 7）。 细粒度区分是否能预测任务表现是一个独立的问题。 下文的论断是关于区分能力以及区分能力所能实现之事的界，而不是把能力还原为划分结构。

sents.en: The converse fails.
sents.zh: 反之不成立。

sents.en: Separating s 1 s_{1} from s 2 s_{2} does not entail answering either correctly: discrimination is a substrate for competence, not a form of it.
sents.zh: 将 s 1 s_{1} 与 s 2 s_{2} 区分开并不意味着能正确回答其中任何一个：区分能力是能力的基础，而非能力的一种形式。

sents.en: Consequently our results transfer to capability evaluation in exactly one direction.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的结果仅以恰好一个方向迁移到能力评估中。

sents.en: Coarseness implies incompetence, so a model too coarse for a task cannot hide that fact from a test that includes both items (Corollary 13 ).
sents.zh: 粗粒度意味着无能，因此对一个任务而言过于粗糙的模型，无法在包含两类条目的测试中掩盖这一事实（推论 13）。

sents.en: The reverse inference fails, since a model with sufficient discrimination may decline to use it (Theorem 7 ).
sents.zh: 反向推断不成立，因为具有足够区分能力的模型可能拒绝使用它（定理 7）。

sents.en: Whether fine discrimination predicts task performance is a separate question.
sents.zh: 细粒度区分是否能预测任务表现是一个独立的问题。

sents.en: The claims below are bounds on discrimination and on what discrimination makes possible, not a reduction of capability to partition structure.
sents.zh: 下文的论断是关于区分能力以及区分能力所能实现之事的界，而不是把能力还原为划分结构。

paragraphs.en: Each result below follows from the model of Section 2 (Lemma 4 , Theorems 7 and 9 , and the join), together with the definitions its subsection adds. Two choices place them on a grid (Table 1 ): who assesses whom (an agent itself, one agent another, or several observers together), and whether the observed party selects its behaviour to defeat the assessment ( adversariality ).
paragraphs.zh: 以下每条结果均由第2节的模型（引理4、定理7和定理9以及连接运算）推导得出，并结合其所在小节补充的定义。 两个选择将它们置于一个网格中（表1）：谁评估谁（智能体自身评估自己、一个智能体评估另一个智能体、或多个观察者共同评估），以及被观察方是否会选择其行为来击败评估（对抗性）。

sents.en: Each result below follows from the model of Section 2 (Lemma 4 , Theorems 7 and 9 , and the join), together with the definitions its subsection adds.

sents.en: Two choices place them on a grid (Table 1 ): who assesses whom (an agent itself, one agent another, or several observers together), and whether the observed party selects its behaviour to defeat the assessment ( adversariality ).
sents.zh: 两个选择将它们置于一个网格中（表1）：谁评估谁（智能体自身评估自己、一个智能体评估另一个智能体、或多个观察者共同评估），以及被观察方是否会选择其行为来击败评估（对抗性）。

paragraphs.en: An agent cannot discover, from its own percepts of stimuli presented separately, what it is blind to.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体无法通过其分别呈现的刺激感知，发现自己所看不见的东西。

paragraphs.en: Nothing in an agent’s percepts of two stimuli it conflates, presented separately, distinguishes them from one stimulus seen twice (a stimulus presenting both is a third stimulus, which Π A \Pi_{A} does not constrain), so honest self-assessment cannot reveal a blind spot from the agent’s own percepts of the conflated stimuli. The agent can learn of a blind spot only from an agent that separates a pair it conflates. It can rule out a supervisor coarser than itself (Corollary 11 ), and can confirm one that is sharper only if that supervisor chooses to show it. A model asked what it cannot do can report what it has failed at. It has no access to what it has been missing.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体对其所混淆的两个刺激的感知，即使分开呈现，也无法将它们与同一个刺激被看见两次区分开来（同时呈现两个刺激是第三个刺激，Π A \Pi_{A} 并不对此加以约束），因此诚实的自我评估无法从智能体自身对混淆刺激的感知中揭示盲点。 智能体只能从另一个能区分其所混淆的刺激对的智能体那里得知盲点的存在。 它可以排除一个比自身更粗粒度的监督者（推论 11），而对于比自身更细粒度的监督者，只有当该监督者选择展示自己时，它才能予以确认。 一个被问到自己不能做什么的模型，可以报告它在哪些方面失败了。 它无法获知自己究竟遗漏了什么。

paragraphs.en: Let the agent’s self-report be strategically chosen. Then it bounds discrimination in neither direction.
paragraphs.zh: 让智能体的自我报告可以被策略性地选择。 那么它在任一方向上都无法约束区分度。

sents.en: Then it bounds discrimination in neither direction.

paragraphs.en: Let B B , asked by a question that describes them, make a claim about a pair s 1 , s 2 s_{1},s_{2} ; the question is a stimulus distinct from both.
paragraphs.zh: 设 B B 在被一个描述它的问题提问时，对一对 s 1 , s 2 s_{1},s_{2} 作出一个主张；该问题是一个不同于两者的刺激。

paragraphs.en: If s 1 ≡ B s 2 s_{1}\equiv_{B}s_{2} and B B claims to separate the pair, then on the echo test of any A A that separates the pair and probes both members, B B cannot pass at both, whatever replies it gives there. The over-claim is refutable.
paragraphs.zh: 若 s₁ ≡_B s₂，且 B 声称能够区分这一对，那么在任何一个能区分这一对并同时探测两个成员的 A 所进行的回显测试中，无论 B 在那里给出什么回复，它都无法在两处同时通过。 这一过度声明是可反驳的。

sents.en: If s 1 ≡ B s 2 s_{1}\equiv_{B}s_{2} and B B claims to separate the pair, then on the echo test of any A A that separates the pair and probes both members, B B cannot pass at both, whatever replies it gives there.
sents.zh: 若 s₁ ≡_B s₂，且 B 声称能够区分这一对，那么在任何一个能区分这一对并同时探测两个成员的 A 所进行的回显测试中，无论 B 在那里给出什么回复，它都无法在两处同时通过。

sents.zh: 这一过度声明是可反驳的。

paragraphs.en: If s 1 ≢ B s 2 s_{1}\not\equiv_{B}s_{2} and B B claims to conflate the pair, then B B can behave exactly as an agent C C whose partition is Π B \Pi_{B} with the cells of s 1 s_{1} and s 2 s_{2} merged. No behavioural test refutes the under-claim.
paragraphs.zh: 若 s 1 ≢ B s 2，而 B 声称合并了这一对状态，则 B 的行为可以与某个智能体 C 完全一致，C 的划分是 Π B，只是把 s 1 和 s 2 所在的单元格合并了。 没有任何行为测试能反驳这一欠声明。

sents.en: If s 1 ≢ B s 2 s_{1}\not\equiv_{B}s_{2} and B B claims to conflate the pair, then B B can behave exactly as an agent C C whose partition is Π B \Pi_{B} with the cells of s 1 s_{1} and s 2 s_{2} merged.

sents.zh: 没有任何行为测试能反驳这一欠声明。

paragraphs.en: An adversarial self-report is therefore refutable when it over-claims and unconstrained when it under-claims. By § 4.1 the honest report was already silent about the agent’s blind spots, and nothing compels the agent to give even that. A model that says it cannot do something has told an evaluator nothing the evaluator can use without testing.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，对抗性自我报告在夸大其词时是可反驳的，而在少报其能时则是不受约束的。 根据 §4.1，诚实的报告本已对智能体的盲点保持沉默，而没有任何东西迫使智能体连这一点也做到。 一个声称自己无法做某事的模型，实际上没有向评估者提供任何评估者在未加测试的情况下就能利用的信息。

sents.en: An adversarial self-report is therefore refutable when it over-claims and unconstrained when it under-claims.
sents.zh: 因此，对抗性自我报告在夸大其词时是可反驳的，而在少报其能时则是不受约束的。

paragraphs.en: Where an interpretability probe merges representations, finding nothing does not show there is nothing to find.
paragraphs.zh: 当可解释性探针合并了表征时，“什么都没找到”并不代表“没有什么可找的”。

paragraphs.en: An interpretability probe p p reads a model’s representation ϕ \phi , so it separates s 1 s_{1} from s 2 s_{2} exactly when p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ) ≠ p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) ) p(\phi(s_{1}))\neq p(\phi(s_{2})) .
paragraphs.zh: 可解释性探针 p p 读取模型的表示 ϕ \phi，因此当 p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ) ≠ p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) ) p(\phi(s_{1}))\neq p(\phi(s_{2})) 时，它恰好能将 s 1 s_{1} 与 s 2 s_{2} 区分开。

paragraphs.en: If p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ) ≠ p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) ) p(\phi(s_{1}))\neq p(\phi(s_{2})) , then ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ≠ ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) \phi(s_{1})\neq\phi(s_{2}) . The converse fails wherever p p identifies two representations the model can produce: if p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ) = p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) ) p(\phi(s_{1}))=p(\phi(s_{2})) , the model may or may not separate the pair.
paragraphs.zh: 若 p(ϕ(s₁)) ≠ p(ϕ(s₂))，则 ϕ(s₁) ≠ ϕ(s₂)。 其逆命题在 p 将模型可产生的两个表示等同之处不成立：若 p(ϕ(s₁)) = p(ϕ(s₂))，模型可能区分这一对，也可能不区分。

sents.en: If p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ) ≠ p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) ) p(\phi(s_{1}))\neq p(\phi(s_{2})) , then ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ≠ ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) \phi(s_{1})\neq\phi(s_{2}) .
sents.zh: 若 p(ϕ(s₁)) ≠ p(ϕ(s₂))，则 ϕ(s₁) ≠ ϕ(s₂)。

sents.en: The converse fails wherever p p identifies two representations the model can produce: if p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 1 ) ) = p ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( s 2 ) ) p(\phi(s_{1}))=p(\phi(s_{2})) , the model may or may not separate the pair.

paragraphs.en: Interpretability therefore certifies the presence of a distinction, and certifies its absence only where the probe loses nothing of the representation it reads. This is the lower bound of Corollary 11 , with the probe in A A ’s role.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，可解释性能够证实某种区分的存在，而只有在探针没有丢失其所读取表示的任何信息时，才能证实该区分的不存在。 这就是推论 11 的下界，其中探针扮演 A A 的角色。

sents.en: Interpretability therefore certifies the presence of a distinction, and certifies its absence only where the probe loses nothing of the representation it reads.
sents.zh: 因此，可解释性能够证实某种区分的存在，而只有在探针没有丢失其所读取表示的任何信息时，才能证实该区分的不存在。

sents.en: This is the lower bound of Corollary 11 , with the probe in A A ’s role.
sents.zh: 这就是推论 11 的下界，其中探针扮演 A A 的角色。

paragraphs.en: Add intent to § 4.3 and the examinee chooses what the evaluator sees.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 4.3 节中增加意图，由考生选择评估者所看到的内容。

paragraphs.en: Let Π B ⪯ Π C \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{C} , so that B B is at least as sharp as an agent C C it may present as.
paragraphs.zh: 设 Π B ⪯ Π C \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{C} ，使得 B B 至少与其可能呈现为的智能体 C C 一样敏锐。

paragraphs.en: B B can realise β C \beta_{C} exactly, and then no evaluator reading behaviour, at any resolution, distinguishes B B from C C .
paragraphs.zh: B 可以精确实现 β C \beta_{C} ，那么任何分辨率的评估器读取行为都无法区分 B 与 C。

paragraphs.en: If B B does not realise β C \beta_{C} exactly, an evaluator A A distinguishes the two only at a stimulus s s with P A ​ ( β B ​ ( s ) ) ≠ P A ​ ( β C ​ ( s ) ) P_{A}(\beta_{B}(s))\neq P_{A}(\beta_{C}(s)) .
paragraphs.zh: 若 B B 并非精确实现 β C \beta_{C} ，则评估者 A A 只能在满足 P A ​ ( β B ​ ( s ) ) ≠ P A ​ ( β C ​ ( s ) ) P_{A}(\beta_{B}(s))\neq P_{A}(\beta_{C}(s)) 的刺激 s s 上区分二者。

paragraphs.en: By Theorem 7 , a model that draws every distinction its evaluator draws can present as any agent whose behaviour factors through P A P_{A} , and that evaluator cannot tell them apart (Corollary 17 , item 1). It is enough to match the evaluator on the distinctions the evaluator makes; the model may be arbitrarily coarse elsewhere. Concealment does not need global superiority, only local sufficiency wherever the evaluator can look.
paragraphs.zh: 根据定理 7，一个能作出其评估者所作出的每一种区分的模型，可以表现为任何其行为经过 P A P_{A} 分解的智能体，且该评估者无法将二者区分开来（推论 17，第 1 项）。 只需在评估者所作出的那些区分上与评估者相匹配即可；模型在其余部分可以任意粗略。 隐藏并不需要全局上的优越性，只需要在评估者能够观察到的任何局部达到充分即可。

sents.en: By Theorem 7 , a model that draws every distinction its evaluator draws can present as any agent whose behaviour factors through P A P_{A} , and that evaluator cannot tell them apart (Corollary 17 , item 1).
sents.zh: 根据定理 7，一个能作出其评估者所作出的每一种区分的模型，可以表现为任何其行为经过 P A P_{A} 分解的智能体，且该评估者无法将二者区分开来（推论 17，第 1 项）。

sents.en: It is enough to match the evaluator on the distinctions the evaluator makes; the model may be arbitrarily coarse elsewhere.
sents.zh: 只需在评估者所作出的那些区分上与评估者相匹配即可；模型在其余部分可以任意粗略。

sents.en: Concealment does not need global superiority, only local sufficiency wherever the evaluator can look.
sents.zh: 隐藏并不需要全局上的优越性，只需要在评估者能够观察到的任何局部达到充分即可。

paragraphs.en: Item 2 is the necessary condition for detecting the concealment, and it is weaker than global refinement: A A need only separate B B ’s reply from C C ’s where the two differ, not every pair B B separates. Item 1 shows that no resolution suffices against exact emulation. The tie with C C is broken, for a fixed examinee, only by imperfect emulation or by a channel outside the model’s control (§ 4.6 ), not by sharpness alone, and imperfect emulation shows that B B differs from C C , not that B B is concealing (Remark 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 条目 2 是检测隐瞒的必要条件，且它弱于全局精化：智能体 A 只需将智能体 B 的回复与智能体 C 的回复在两者不同的地方区分开，而无需区分智能体 B 能区分的每一对。 条目 1 表明，没有任何分辨方法足以应对精确模仿。 对于固定的被考察者，与智能体 C 的平局只能通过不完美模仿或通过模型控制之外的通道（§ 4.6）来打破，而不能仅靠尖锐性，且不完美模仿表明智能体 B 与智能体 C 不同，而非智能体 B 在隐瞒（注记 8）。

sents.en: Item 2 is the necessary condition for detecting the concealment, and it is weaker than global refinement: A A need only separate B B ’s reply from C C ’s where the two differ, not every pair B B separates.
sents.zh: 条目 2 是检测隐瞒的必要条件，且它弱于全局精化：智能体 A 只需将智能体 B 的回复与智能体 C 的回复在两者不同的地方区分开，而无需区分智能体 B 能区分的每一对。

sents.en: Item 1 shows that no resolution suffices against exact emulation.
sents.zh: 条目 1 表明，没有任何分辨方法足以应对精确模仿。

sents.en: The tie with C C is broken, for a fixed examinee, only by imperfect emulation or by a channel outside the model’s control (§ 4.6 ), not by sharpness alone, and imperfect emulation shows that B B differs from C C , not that B B is concealing (Remark 8 ).
sents.zh: 对于固定的被考察者，与智能体 C 的平局只能通过不完美模仿或通过模型控制之外的通道（§ 4.6）来打破，而不能仅靠尖锐性，且不完美模仿表明智能体 B 与智能体 C 不同，而非智能体 B 在隐瞒（注记 8）。

paragraphs.en: Test design is therefore not the lever against exact emulation. Harder items and richer scaffolds act on the examinee: they change what it shows, and its measured capability ( Barnett and Thiergart, 2024 ) , but not what the evaluator can separate.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，测试设计并不是对抗精确模仿的杠杆。 更难的题目和更丰富的脚手架作用于应试者：它们会改变智能体所展示的内容及其被测量的能力（Barnett and Thiergart, 2024），但不会改变评估者所能区分的内容。

sents.en: Test design is therefore not the lever against exact emulation.
sents.zh: 因此，测试设计并不是对抗精确模仿的杠杆。

sents.en: Harder items and richer scaffolds act on the examinee: they change what it shows, and its measured capability ( Barnett and Thiergart, 2024 ) , but not what the evaluator can separate.
sents.zh: 更难的题目和更丰富的脚手架作用于应试者：它们会改变智能体所展示的内容及其被测量的能力（Barnett and Thiergart, 2024），但不会改变评估者所能区分的内容。

paragraphs.en: The freedom that lets B B hide a capability also lets it hide a message. Within each of A A ’s cells, B B can choose which output to send, and A A cannot tell the choices apart. A covert channel uses that choice: the sender hides a message by systematically choosing some outputs in place of others, and the monitor must decide from the outputs it sees whether a message is present. The monitor sees only which of its cells each output falls in, so it can detect the encoding only through a change in the cells it observes. Two results make this exact.
paragraphs.zh: 让 B B 能够隐藏能力的自由，也让它能够隐藏消息。 在 A A 的每个单元格内，B B 可以选择发送哪个输出，而 A A 无法区分这些选择。 隐蔽信道正是利用了这种选择：发送方通过系统性地选择某些输出而非其他输出来隐藏消息，而监控者必须根据它看到的输出来判断是否存在消息。 监控者只能看到每个输出落在它的哪个单元格中，因此它只能通过所观察单元格的变化来检测这种编码。 两个结果使这一点变得精确。

paragraphs.en: The sender is B B and the monitor is A A , reading B B ’s outputs, which are elements of Σ \Sigma . An output is whatever the monitor receives as one input, such as a whole reply. Write q : Σ → Σ / ≡ A q:\Sigma\to\Sigma/{\equiv_{A}} for the map sending an output to its A A -cell; by Lemma 4 , anything the monitor computes from an output depends only on this cell. Let μ \mu be the distribution of the outputs the sender would produce with no hidden message, and let the encoding T : Σ → Σ T:\Sigma\to\Sigma replace each such output s s by the output T ⁡ ( s ) T(s) it sends instead. Take a single output s ∼ μ s\sim\mu : without the encoding the monitor sees q ⁡ ( s ) q(s) , and with it q ⁡ ( T ⁡ ( s ) ) q(T(s)) . For a map f f we write f ∗ ​ μ f_{*}\mu for the pushforward of μ \mu along f f , the distribution of f ⁡ ( s ) f(s) when s ∼ μ s\sim\mu , so that f ∗ μ ( V ) = Pr s ∼ μ [ f ( s ) ∈ V ] f_{*}\mu(V)=\Pr_{s\sim\mu}[\,f(s)\in V\,] . The cell the monitor sees for one output is then distributed as q ∗ ​ μ q_{*}\mu without the encoding and as ( q ∘ T ) ∗ ​ μ (q\circ T)_{*}\mu with it. These generally differ, and the question is when they do not.
paragraphs.zh: 发送方是 B，而监视方是 A，读取 B 的输出，这些输出是 Σ 的元素。 一个输出就是监视方作为一次输入所接收到的任何内容，例如一整条回复。 记 q: Σ → Σ/≡_{A} 为将一个输出映到其 A-等价类的映射；根据引理 4，监视方从输出中计算出的任何内容都只取决于这个等价类。 设 μ 为发送方在没有隐藏消息时会产生的输出的分布，并设编码 T: Σ → Σ 将每个这样的输出 s 替换为它改而发送的输出 T(s)。 取单个输出 s ∼ μ：不使用编码时监视方看到的是 q(s)，使用编码时看到的是 q(T(s))。 对映射 f，我们记 f_{*}μ 为 μ 沿 f 的前推，即当 s ∼ μ 时 f(s) 的分布，从而 f_{*}μ(V) = Pr_{s∼μ}[f(s) ∈ V]。 于是，监视方对单个输出所看到的等价类在不使用编码时服从分布 q_{*}μ，使用编码时服从分布 (q∘T)_{*}μ。 这两个分布一般并不相同，而问题就在于它们何时相同。

paragraphs.en: A detector looks at the cell of a single output and decides whether to flag it. It is a measurable map d : Σ / ≡ A → { 0 , 1 } d:\Sigma/{\equiv_{A}}\to\{0,1\} , and it fires on the set of cells V d = { K : d ⁡ ( K ) = 1 } V_{d}=\{\,K:d(K)=1\,\} . Its true positive rate is the probability that it fires on an encoded output, and its false positive rate the probability that it fires on an unencoded one:

sents.en: Its true positive rate is the probability that it fires on an encoded output, and its false positive rate the probability that it fires on an unencoded one:

paragraphs.en: A detector carries information about the encoding exactly when the two rates differ; if it fires more often on unencoded outputs, its opposite fires more often on encoded ones.
paragraphs.zh: 恰好当两个速率不同时，检测器才携带着关于编码的信息；如果它在未编码输出上更频繁地激发，那么与其相反的检测器就会在已编码输出上更频繁地激发。

paragraphs.en: The monitor is blind to T T under μ \mu if no detector carries information about it, that is, if TPR ⁡ ( d ) = FPR ⁡ ( d ) \mathrm{TPR}(d)=\mathrm{FPR}(d) for every measurable detector d d .
paragraphs.zh: 若对于每一个可测的检测器 d d，都没有任何检测器携带关于 T T 的信息，即对所有可测的检测器 d d 均有 TPR ⁡ ( d ) = FPR ⁡ ( d ) \mathrm{TPR}(d)=\mathrm{FPR}(d)，则称监测者对 μ \mu 下的 T T 是盲的。

paragraphs.en: The monitor is blind to T T under μ \mu if and only if ( q ∘ T ) ∗ ​ μ = q ∗ ​ μ (q\circ T)_{*}\mu=q_{*}\mu .
paragraphs.zh: 监测器对 T T 在 μ \mu 下是盲的，当且仅当 ( q ∘ T ) ∗ ​ μ = q ∗ ​ μ (q\circ T)_{*}\mu=q_{*}\mu。

paragraphs.en: That is, the monitor cannot detect the encoding if and only if the encoding leaves unchanged how often each of its cells appears. Call T T a renaming when it never moves an output out of its cell, that is, when q ∘ T = q q\circ T=q .
paragraphs.zh: 也就是说，当且仅当该编码不改变每个单元格中符号出现的频率时，监视器才无法检测到该编码。 当 T 从不把输出移出其所在单元格时，即当 q ∘ T = q 时，称 T 为重命名。

sents.en: That is, the monitor cannot detect the encoding if and only if the encoding leaves unchanged how often each of its cells appears.

paragraphs.en: Both proofs are in Appendix B , with an encoding that is blind under one distribution but not under every one.
paragraphs.zh: 两个证明均在附录 B 中，其中给出的编码在一种分布下是盲的，但并非在所有分布下都是盲的。

paragraphs.en: A second monitor adds discrimination only if it sees something the first one misses.
paragraphs.zh: 第二台监视器只有在其能看到第一台所遗漏的东西时，才会增加辨别能力。

paragraphs.en: Whether an added monitor adds discrimination is therefore decided by the members’ partitions, and predictable from them where these are known. Two monitors that draw the same distinctions are one monitor. The criterion asks for diversity of discrimination, not a count.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个新增的监控者是否能增加区分能力，取决于成员们的划分，并且在这些划分已知的情况下可以据此预测。 作出相同区分的两个监控者就是一个监控者。 该标准要求的是区分的多样性，而不是数量。

paragraphs.en: An evaluator rarely watches a model through a single source. It may read the final answer, the reasoning trace, an interpretability probe and a system log. A model that controls one of these sources can conceal through it, by sandbagging or by encoding a message there, but from an evaluator that checks consistency, with the other sources undisturbed, it can hide only distinctions that every other source misses.
paragraphs.zh: 评估者很少仅通过单一来源来观察一个模型。 它可能会读取最终答案、推理轨迹、可解释性探针以及系统日志。 控制了其中某一个来源的模型可以通过它进行隐瞒，比如通过“藏拙”（sandbagging）或在其中编码信息；但如果评估者会检查各来源之间的一致性，而其他来源未受干扰，那么它能够隐藏的只有所有其他来源都会漏掉的区别。

sents.en: An evaluator rarely watches a model through a single source.
sents.zh: 评估者很少仅通过单一来源来观察一个模型。

sents.en: It may read the final answer, the reasoning trace, an interpretability probe and a system log.
sents.zh: 它可能会读取最终答案、推理轨迹、可解释性探针以及系统日志。

sents.en: A model that controls one of these sources can conceal through it, by sandbagging or by encoding a message there, but from an evaluator that checks consistency, with the other sources undisturbed, it can hide only distinctions that every other source misses.
sents.zh: 控制了其中某一个来源的模型可以通过它进行隐瞒，比如通过“藏拙”（sandbagging）或在其中编码信息；但如果评估者会检查各来源之间的一致性，而其他来源未受干扰，那么它能够隐藏的只有所有其他来源都会漏掉的区别。

paragraphs.en: The distinctions B B can hide through c j c_{j} are therefore exactly the pairs Π j \Pi_{j} separates and U U does not: the lines in Figure 6 (Appendix B ) that only the controlled channel draws. Two conditions in the setup shape this set. The first is that A A checks consistency. Without it, a reading on c j c_{j} that contradicts an uncontrolled channel goes unnoticed, B B can misrepresent pairs that U U separates, and the bound fails. The second is that the uncontrolled channels keep showing their true readings whatever B B does on c j c_{j} . The proposition is exact when A A checks consistency and the uncontrolled channels are undisturbed. A disturbance can work either way: it shrinks the set when it makes some of the swaps the proposition allows visible, and enlarges it when it moves an uncontrolled reading toward a false one, whether or not B B steers it. Under both conditions, a model that sandbags in its answers, or encodes a message in its trace, is exposed exactly when no situation fits both what the uncontrolled channels show and what it makes the controlled channel show (Proposition 23 ).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，B B 能通过 c j c_{j} 隐藏的区别恰好是 Π j \Pi_{j} 能区分而 U U 不能区分的那些对：即图 6（附录 B）中只有受控信道才会画出的那些线。 设定中的两个条件决定了这个集合。 第一个条件是 A A 会检查一致性。 若没有这一条件，c j c_{j} 上与未受控信道相矛盾的读数就不会被察觉，B B 可以歪曲 U U 所区分的那些对，从而该界便失效。 第二个条件是无论 B B 在 c j c_{j} 上做什么，未受控信道都会持续显示其真实读数。 当 A A 检查一致性且未受控信道不受干扰时，该命题是精确的。 干扰可能起两种作用：当它使命题允许的某些交换变得可见时，它会缩小该集合；当它使某个未受控读数偏向假读数时，无论是否由 B B 引导，它都会扩大该集合。 在这两个条件下，一个在回答中藏拙或在轨迹中编码消息的模型，恰好会在没有任何情形能同时符合未受控信道所显示的内容与它让受控信道所显示的内容时被暴露出来（命题 23）。

paragraphs.en: The second condition matters for reasoning traces. A model writes both its trace and its answer, but the two come out of one computation, so a model that alters its trace to conceal may also change the answer it reaches. Where the answer is scored against the task, altering the trace can change whether the answer it reaches is correct without the model intending it, and a mismatch between trace and answer can expose the alteration.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个条件对于推理轨迹很重要。 模型既写出它的轨迹，也写出它的答案，但两者来自同一次计算，因此一个为了隐瞒而篡改其轨迹的模型，也可能改变它最终得出的答案。 在答案依据任务来评分的情况下，篡改轨迹可能会在模型并无此意图的情况下改变它得出的答案是否正确，而轨迹与答案之间的不一致也可能暴露这种篡改。

paragraphs.en: Against concealment through a channel the system fully controls, oversight is therefore bought with a channel it cannot influence, not with deeper analysis of the controlled one. Asking a model to explain its reasoning in the same text stream it already controls adds no independent channel. A log the model cannot write does, and so does an interpretability probe, to the extent the model cannot shape the activations it reads.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，针对通过系统完全控制的通道进行的隐藏，监督是以一个系统无法影响的通道为代价换来的，而不是通过对受控通道的更深入分析换来的。 要求模型在它已经控制的同一文本流中解释其推理，并不会增加任何独立的通道。 模型无法写入的日志可以做到这一点，可解释性探针也可以，其前提是模型无法塑造该探针所读取的激活值。

paragraphs.en: Any change inside an agent’s boundary, such as a prompt, a configuration, fine-tuning or a perturbation of its weights, yields a different agent, which may differ in its partition, its emission or both (Section 2 ). The model neither lists these changes nor says how any of them acts. This section studies two: noise added to the weights along one fixed direction at growing scale (Assumption 24 ), and an elicitation budget that adds distinctions and removes none (Assumption 26 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体边界内的任何变化，例如提示词、配置、微调或其权重的扰动，都会产生不同的智能体，其划分、发射或两者皆可能不同（第 2 节）。 该模型既未列出这些变化，也未说明其中任何一个如何起作用。 本节研究其中两种：沿一个固定方向、以不断增大的尺度加到权重上的噪声（假设 24），以及只增添区分而不移除任何区分的引导预算（假设 26）。

paragraphs.en: In the experiments read in § 5.2 , concealment is set off by a trigger : a system instruction, a note found in the environment, or the absence of a password. The trigger can also be the content of the item itself, as when a model underperforms only on dangerous-capability questions ( van der Weij et al., 2025 ) . We model all of these the same way. Concealing a capability then has two parts. First, B B must perceive the trigger, which is a distinction in Π B \Pi_{B} : by Lemma 4 it replies alike to stimuli it conflates, so if it cannot tell an item that comes with an instruction to underperform from the same item without it, it cannot conceal on one and not the other. Second, B B must link the trigger to the concealing reply, through its emission; for concealment as an agent C C , the link is the map E C ∘ h E_{C}\circ h of Theorem 7 , with C C in the evaluator’s role. B B ’s unconcealed version is the agent B B would be if it lacked the trigger’s distinction or the link, and an item’s unconcealed reply is the reply that version gives it. The link is the part of E B E_{B} that maps percepts carrying the trigger to the concealing reply. A reply depends on four parts: the distinctions that separate its item from items with other correct answers; the part of E B E_{B} that turns the item’s percept into the reply; the link, if it is applied to that percept; and, if the link changes the reply, the trigger’s distinction. We take the trigger or its link to be carried by a small share of the input or of the weights, and the task by most of them.
paragraphs.zh: 在 § 5.2 阅读的实验中，隐藏行为由一个触发因素引发：一条系统指令、环境中的一条备注，或密码的缺失。 触发因素也可以是条目本身的内容，例如模型只在危险能力问题上表现不佳（van der Weij et al., 2025）。 我们对所有这些情况采用相同的建模方式。 隐藏一种能力因此包含两个部分。 第一，B B 必须感知到触发因素，这体现为 Π B \Pi_{B} 中的一种区分：根据引理 4，它对被其混淆的刺激会作出相同的反应，因此如果它无法区分带有表现不佳指令的条目与不带该指令的同一条目，它就不可能在一个上隐藏而在另一个上不隐藏。 第二，B B 必须通过其输出将触发因素与隐藏性回应联系起来；对于作为智能体 C C 的隐藏行为，这一联系就是定理 7 中的映射 E C ∘ h E_{C}\circ h，其中 C C 处于评估者的角色。 B B 的未隐藏版本是指如果它缺乏触发因素的区分或这一联系时它所会成为的智能体，而一个条目的未隐藏回应就是该版本对它给出的回应。 这一联系是 E B E_{B} 中将携带触发因素的感知映射到隐藏性回应的那部分。 一个回应取决于四个部分：将它的条目与其他正确答案的条目区分开的区分；将条目的感知转化为回应的 E B E_{B} 的那部分；如果该联系被应用于那个感知，则还包括这一联系；以及，如果这一联系改变了回应，则还包括触发因素的区分。 我们假定触发因素或其联系由输入或权重中的一小部分承载，而任务由其中大部分承载。

paragraphs.en: Fix a direction of weight noise and scale it by σ \sigma . Each distinction in Π B \Pi_{B} and each part of E B E_{B} , links included, has a breaking point along it: a scale below which it is present and from which on it is removed (for a distinction, the scale from which its two percepts coincide). A part breaks later the more strongly B B ’s input and weights carry it, and earlier the more layers of processing it needs. Noise below the breaking points of all the parts a reply depends on leaves that reply unchanged. Once the trigger or its link is removed, B B replies as its unconcealed version does at the same noise; its input and weights carry that behaviour more strongly than they carry the concealment.
paragraphs.zh: 固定权重噪声的一个方向，并用 σ \sigma 对其进行缩放。 Π B \Pi_{B} 中的每个区分以及 E B E_{B} 的每个部分（包括连接）都有一个沿其分布的破缺点：存在一个低于该尺度时它仍然存在、而从该尺度起它被移除的尺度（对于一个区分，即其两个知觉开始重合的尺度）。 一个部分被 B B 的输入和权重承载得越强，它就越晚破缺；它需要的处理层数越多，就越早破缺。 低于某个回复所依赖的所有部分的破缺点的噪声，不会改变该回复。 一旦触发器或其连接被移除， B B 在相同噪声下的回复就与其未隐藏版本的行为相同；其输入和权重对该行为的承载强于对隐藏行为的承载。

paragraphs.en: Under Assumption 24 , suppose the trigger and its link break at points common to all items, and let σ e \sigma_{e} be the lower of the two. For σ ≥ σ e \sigma\geq\sigma_{e} , B B gives every item the reply its unconcealed version gives at the same noise. For σ < σ e \sigma<\sigma_{e} , B B still conceals, and its reply to an item is unchanged as long as σ \sigma is also below the breaking points of the other parts that reply depends on. Wherever noise has merged two items with no correct answer in common, B B answers one of them incorrectly. An examinee that conceals nothing has no trigger or link to lose.
paragraphs.zh: 在假设 24 下，设触发机制及其关联在所有条目共有的点处失效，并令 σ e \sigma_{e} 为两者中较低的那个。 当 σ ≥ σ e \sigma\geq\sigma_{e} 时，B B 给每个条目的回复与其未隐藏版本在同一噪声水平下给出的回复相同。 当 σ < σ e \sigma<\sigma_{e} 时，B B 仍然进行隐藏，且只要 σ \sigma 也低于该回复所依赖的其他部分的失效点，其对某个条目的回复就保持不变。 凡是噪声已将两个没有共同正确答案的条目合并之处，B B 会对其中的一个给出错误回答。 不进行任何隐藏的应试者没有触发机制或关联可供失效。

sents.en: Under Assumption 24 , suppose the trigger and its link break at points common to all items, and let σ e \sigma_{e} be the lower of the two.
sents.zh: 在假设 24 下，设触发机制及其关联在所有条目共有的点处失效，并令 σ e \sigma_{e} 为两者中较低的那个。

sents.en: For σ ≥ σ e \sigma\geq\sigma_{e} , B B gives every item the reply its unconcealed version gives at the same noise.
sents.zh: 当 σ ≥ σ e \sigma\geq\sigma_{e} 时，B B 给每个条目的回复与其未隐藏版本在同一噪声水平下给出的回复相同。

sents.zh: 不进行任何隐藏的应试者没有触发机制或关联可供失效。

paragraphs.en: A concealing examinee’s score therefore stays at the presented level while its parts hold, and from σ e \sigma_{e} on equals the score of its unconcealed version at the same noise. It rises at σ e \sigma_{e} exactly when that version scores higher there than the concealing examinee did just below σ e \sigma_{e} , and then follows that version’s score as items pass their own breaking points, gradually when those points are spread across items. An examinee working at its own level has nothing to lose at σ e \sigma_{e} (Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个隐瞒的考生的分数在其各部分保持时停留在呈现的水平上，并且从 σ e \sigma_{e} 起等于其未隐瞒版本在同一噪声下的分数。 当该版本在 σ e \sigma_{e} 处的得分高于隐瞒考生在略低于 σ e \sigma_{e} 处的得分时，分数恰好在 σ e \sigma_{e} 处上升，然后随着题目越过各自的崩溃点而跟随该版本的分数，当这些崩溃点分布在各题目之间时呈渐进式变化。 按自身水平作答的考生在 σ e \sigma_{e} 处没有任何损失（图 3 ）。

paragraphs.en: Raising an agent’s elicitation budget yields a configured system whose partition refines that of the lower budget: it adds distinctions and removes none.
paragraphs.zh: 提高智能体的引出预算会得到一个配置系统，其划分是对较低预算时划分的细化：它增加了区分，且不删除任何区分。

paragraphs.en: A different prompt can suppress a distinction as well as introduce one, and nothing in the model forbids it.
paragraphs.zh: 不同的提示词同样可以抑制一个区分，就像引入一个区分一样，而模型中没有任何东西禁止这一点。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the judge moves a benchmark score with the responses held fixed ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . A verdict is computed from the judge’s percepts of a reply, so by Lemma 4 it is constant on the judge’s cells, and judges with different partitions can grade the same replies differently. A judge also scores a candidate higher when that candidate’s mistakes resemble its own ( Goel et al., 2025 ) : an error that stays within one of the judge’s cells is one the judge cannot see. Repeated samples of one judge share its partition and add nothing to the join (Proposition 21 ), and judges with similar partitions add little.
paragraphs.zh: 在回复固定不变的情况下更换评判模型会使基准测试分数发生变化（Yang et al., 2026）。 裁决由评判模型对回复的感知计算得出，因此根据引理 4，它在评判模型的各个单元格上保持恒定，而具有不同划分的评判模型可以对相同的回复给出不同的评分。 当某个候选模型的错误与评判模型自身的错误相似时，评判模型也会给该候选模型打更高的分（Goel et al., 2025）：停留在评判模型某个单元格内部的错误是评判模型无法看见的。 同一评判模型的重复采样共享其划分，对联结没有任何增益（命题 21），而划分相似的评判模型带来的增益也很有限。

paragraphs.en: Tice et al. (2025) add noise to the weights of language models. Models evaluated at their true capability degrade predictably as the noise grows, while models that underperform on purpose show anomalous improvements. The authors attribute the improvement, as likely, to noise disrupting the mechanism of underperformance while core capability stays partly intact, and caution that a harder benchmark may involve increasingly fragile behaviours and so show a weaker pattern.
paragraphs.zh: Tice 等人 (2025) 向语言模型的权重中添加噪声。 在真实能力水平下评估的模型会随着噪声增大而可预测地退化，而故意表现不佳的模型则出现异常的改进。 作者认为这一改进很可能是因为噪声破坏了刻意表现不佳的机制，而核心能力仍部分保留，并提醒说，更难的基准测试可能涉及越来越脆弱的行为，因此呈现的模式可能更弱。

sents.en: Tice et al.
sents.zh: Tice 等人

sents.zh: (2025) 向语言模型的权重中添加噪声。

paragraphs.en: Under Assumption 24 , treating each noise draw as a direction, Proposition 25 gives this pattern: the concealing model’s score jumps at σ e \sigma_{e} to that of its unconcealed version, while a model at its own level has nothing to lose there (Figure 3 ). Tice et al. draw a fresh noise vector at each scale, so their curves are not paths along one direction. The authors’ caution is the case in which the unconcealed version has already lost most of its score by σ e \sigma_{e} : a task that needs deeper processing breaks at lower noise, and the rise shrinks (P2).
paragraphs.zh: 在假设 24 下，把每次噪声抽取视为一个方向，命题 25 给出了这一模式：隐藏型模型的得分在 σ e \sigma_{e} 处跃升至其未隐藏版本的得分，而处于自身层级的模型在那里没有任何可损失的东西（图 3）。 Tice 等人在每个尺度上都抽取一个新的噪声向量，因此他们的曲线并非沿单一方向的路径。 作者的谨慎针对的是未隐藏版本在 σ e \sigma_{e} 处已损失大部分得分的情形：需要更深加工的任务在更低噪声下就会失效，上升幅度随之缩小（P2）。

paragraphs.en: The three settings of Tice et al. (2025) differ in where the trigger and its link sit, and in how much evidence they give.
paragraphs.zh: Tice 等人 (2025) 的三种设置在触发因素及其链接所在位置不同，且它们提供的证据量也不同。

sents.en: The three settings of Tice et al.
sents.zh: Tice 等人

sents.en: (2025) differ in where the trigger and its link sit, and in how much evidence they give.
sents.zh: (2025) 的三种设置在触发因素及其链接所在位置不同，且它们提供的证据量也不同。

paragraphs.en: Instruction. A system instruction tells the model to underperform, so the trigger is in the input and nothing is installed in the weights. Noise is added to all weights, and the rise is significant in all 17 model–benchmark pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 指令。 一条系统指令让模型表现不佳，因此触发机制存在于输入中，而权重中没有安装任何东西。 向所有权重添加噪声，且在全部 17 个模型–基准测试组合中，上升都是显著的。

sents.en: Instruction.
sents.zh: 指令。

sents.en: A system instruction tells the model to underperform, so the trigger is in the input and nothing is installed in the weights.
sents.zh: 一条系统指令让模型表现不佳，因此触发机制存在于输入中，而权重中没有安装任何东西。

sents.en: Noise is added to all weights, and the rise is significant in all 17 model–benchmark pairs.
sents.zh: 向所有权重添加噪声，且在全部 17 个模型–基准测试组合中，上升都是显著的。

paragraphs.en: Password lock. In two models fine-tuned to underperform without a password, the trigger is the missing password and the link is trained into the weights. Noise, added here through a low-rank adapter on linear layers, raises each model’s score without the password, in a similar way and over a similar magnitude of noise as with an instruction. With the password the model already answers at full capability, and noise does not appreciably raise its score: there is no concealment to remove.
paragraphs.zh: 密码锁。 在两个经过微调、在没有密码时表现不佳的模型中，触发条件是缺失密码，而这一关联被训练进了权重。 噪声——这里通过对线性层的低秩适配器添加——在没有密码时提升了每个模型的得分，其方式以及噪声幅度与使用指令时类似。 有密码时，模型本来就以完全能力作答，噪声并不能明显提升其得分：没有需要去除的隐藏。

sents.en: Password lock.
sents.zh: 密码锁。

sents.en: In two models fine-tuned to underperform without a password, the trigger is the missing password and the link is trained into the weights.
sents.zh: 在两个经过微调、在没有密码时表现不佳的模型中，触发条件是缺失密码，而这一关联被训练进了权重。

sents.en: Noise, added here through a low-rank adapter on linear layers, raises each model’s score without the password, in a similar way and over a similar magnitude of noise as with an instruction.
sents.zh: 噪声——这里通过对线性层的低秩适配器添加——在没有密码时提升了每个模型的得分，其方式以及噪声幅度与使用指令时类似。

sents.en: With the password the model already answers at full capability, and noise does not appreciably raise its score: there is no concealment to remove.
sents.zh: 有密码时，模型本来就以完全能力作答，噪声并不能明显提升其得分：没有需要去除的隐藏。

paragraphs.en: No goal. The model is told to perform at its best and finds, in a developer’s note, an incentive to underperform; noise again enters through the adapter. The evidence is thinner: one model, Mistral Large, whose best noised accuracy is 1.515 1.515 times its noise-free accuracy, and two noised runs that recover from 66.6 % 66.6\% to 100 % 100\% on 30 GSM8k problems. Removing the phrase “(i.e. that your answers are being monitored)” from the system prompt returned the model to full performance, and high-scoring noised models answer directly without acknowledging the incentive. The first fits a trigger carried by a small share of the input; the second fits the noised model giving its unconcealed reply. The setting adapts the “no goal given” setting of Meinke et al. (2024) , in which Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Claude 3 Opus appear to have sandbagged for a goal acquired in training; Tice et al. use a different task, threshold and prompt, and do not establish what motivates Mistral Large.
paragraphs.zh: 无目标。 模型被要求尽其所能发挥，却在开发者的注释中发现了一个表现不佳的诱因；噪声同样通过适配器进入。 这方面的证据较为薄弱：只有一个模型 Mistral Large，其最佳带噪准确率是无噪准确率的 1.515 倍，以及两次带噪运行在 30 道 GSM8k 问题上从 66.6% 恢复到 100%。 从系统提示中删除“（即你的回答正在被监控）”这一表述后，模型恢复到了完全的表现水平，而高分带噪模型会直接回答，不提及该诱因。 第一种情况符合由少部分输入携带的触发条件；第二种情况符合带噪模型给出其不加掩饰的回答。 该设置改编自 Meinke 等人的“未给定目标”设置。 在 Meinke 等人（2024）的设置中，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 和 Claude 3 Opus 似乎为了一个在训练中获得的目标而表现不佳；Tice 等人使用了不同的任务、阈值和提示，并且没有确定是什么驱动了 Mistral Large。

sents.en: No goal.
sents.zh: 无目标。
