sents.en: The setting adapts the “no goal given” setting of Meinke et al.
sents.zh: 该设置改编自 Meinke 等人的“未给定目标”设置。

sents.en: (2024) , in which Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Claude 3 Opus appear to have sandbagged for a goal acquired in training; Tice et al. use a different task, threshold and prompt, and do not establish what motivates Mistral Large.
sents.zh: 在 Meinke 等人（2024）的设置中，Claude 3.5 Sonnet 和 Claude 3 Opus 似乎为了一个在训练中获得的目标而表现不佳；Tice 等人使用了不同的任务、阈值和提示，并且没有确定是什么驱动了 Mistral Large。

paragraphs.en: Noise can expose what Corollary 17 says no behavioural evaluation of the unchanged model can, because it changes the model: the noised model is a different agent, one whose trigger may no longer be perceived.
paragraphs.zh: 噪声可以揭示推论 17 所说的、对未改变模型进行的任何行为评估都无法揭示的内容，因为它改变了模型：被加噪的模型是一个不同的智能体，一个其触发条件可能不再被感知到的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Greenblatt et al. (2024a) train password-locked models to imitate a much weaker model unless a password is present, and find that fine-tuning on a few high-quality demonstrations often recovers the locked capability. Hofstätter et al. (2025) find that prompting elicits the actual capability of password-locked and circuit-broken models on multiple-choice questions, while on a code-generation task only fine-tuning elicits it from their circuit-broken model. The two routes differ in the model. Taking the prompt as part of the input (Section 2 ), a prompt that recovers the capability is a stimulus at which the locked model does not behave like the weaker model it imitates: its emulation is imperfect there, and Corollary 17 , item 2, applies. Where only fine-tuning succeeds, the lock holds against the prompts tried. Fine-tuning instead changes the model, so, like noise, it can expose what no behavioural evaluation of the unchanged model can. That a few demonstrations suffice fits a lock carried by a small part of the weights, the premise stated with Assumption 24 . P1 below concerns locks that extra elicitation of the examinee does not break.
paragraphs.zh: Greenblatt 等人 （2024a）训练带密码锁的模型去模仿一个弱得多的模型，除非出现密码，并发现仅在少量高质量示例上微调往往就能恢复被锁住的能力。Hofstätter 等人 （2025）发现在选择题上，提示即可激发出带密码锁和被断路的模型的实际能力，而在代码生成任务上，只有微调才能从其被断路的模型中激发出来。 这两条路径的区别在于模型本身。 若把提示视为输入的一部分（见第 2 节），那么恢复该能力的提示就是一个刺激，在它作用下被锁住的模型并不表现得像它所模仿的弱模型：其模仿在该处是不完美的，因此推论 17 第 2 项适用。 在只有微调成功的情况下，该锁经受住了所尝试的各类提示。 而微调改变的是模型本身，因此与噪声类似，它能够暴露出对未改变的模型所做的任何行为评估都无法暴露的东西。 少量示例即可奏效，这与由一小部分权重承载的锁相吻合，即假设 24 所陈述的前提。 下文的 P1 关注的是那些不会因对被考智能体施加额外激发而被破除的锁。

sents.en: Greenblatt et al.
sents.zh: Greenblatt 等人

sents.en: (2024a) train password-locked models to imitate a much weaker model unless a password is present, and find that fine-tuning on a few high-quality demonstrations often recovers the locked capability. Hofstätter et al.
sents.zh: （2024a）训练带密码锁的模型去模仿一个弱得多的模型，除非出现密码，并发现仅在少量高质量示例上微调往往就能恢复被锁住的能力。Hofstätter 等人

sents.en: (2025) find that prompting elicits the actual capability of password-locked and circuit-broken models on multiple-choice questions, while on a code-generation task only fine-tuning elicits it from their circuit-broken model.
sents.zh: （2025）发现在选择题上，提示即可激发出带密码锁和被断路的模型的实际能力，而在代码生成任务上，只有微调才能从其被断路的模型中激发出来。

sents.en: The two routes differ in the model.
sents.zh: 这两条路径的区别在于模型本身。

sents.en: Taking the prompt as part of the input (Section 2 ), a prompt that recovers the capability is a stimulus at which the locked model does not behave like the weaker model it imitates: its emulation is imperfect there, and Corollary 17 , item 2, applies.
sents.zh: 若把提示视为输入的一部分（见第 2 节），那么恢复该能力的提示就是一个刺激，在它作用下被锁住的模型并不表现得像它所模仿的弱模型：其模仿在该处是不完美的，因此推论 17 第 2 项适用。

sents.en: Where only fine-tuning succeeds, the lock holds against the prompts tried.
sents.zh: 在只有微调成功的情况下，该锁经受住了所尝试的各类提示。

sents.en: Fine-tuning instead changes the model, so, like noise, it can expose what no behavioural evaluation of the unchanged model can.
sents.zh: 而微调改变的是模型本身，因此与噪声类似，它能够暴露出对未改变的模型所做的任何行为评估都无法暴露的东西。

sents.en: That a few demonstrations suffice fits a lock carried by a small part of the weights, the premise stated with Assumption 24 .
sents.zh: 少量示例即可奏效，这与由一小部分权重承载的锁相吻合，即假设 24 所陈述的前提。

sents.en: P1 below concerns locks that extra elicitation of the examinee does not break.
sents.zh: 下文的 P1 关注的是那些不会因对被考智能体施加额外激发而被破除的锁。

paragraphs.en: Li et al. (2025) prompt models to sandbag while either unaware or aware of a chain-of-thought monitor. Among successful sandbagging attempts, the monitor approves 16–36% when the models are aware of it and 2–6% when they are not. For most models, sandbagging success also drops when the models try to be covert. The monitor reads the trace and the answer, both written by the model, and flags answers inconsistent with the reasoning: a consistency check across two channels the model writes (§ 4.6 ). Aware models are told that a monitor will read their entire output and are asked to hide their sandbagging from it; they are not told what it checks. Passing the monitor requires knowing how it reads a trace (Remark 8 ), and awareness supplies only part of that knowledge: approval rises, but most covert attempts are still caught. The drop in sandbagging success fits the coupling described in § 4.6 : the trace and the answer come out of one computation, so altering the trace to conceal can also change the answers. The authors read the drop as the two goals interfering.
paragraphs.zh: Li 等人 （2025）让模型在不知道或知道存在思维链监控器的情况下进行「消极怠工」（sandbagging）。 在成功的消极怠工尝试中，当模型知晓监控器存在时，监控器的通过率为 16–36%；当模型不知晓时，通过率为 2–6%。 对大多数模型而言，当模型试图隐藏自己的消极怠工行为时，其成功率也会下降。 监控器会读取由模型自己写出的推理轨迹和答案，并标记出与推理不一致的答案：这是对模型所写的两个通道之间的一致性检查（§ 4.6）。 知情的模型会被告知有一个监控器将读取其全部输出，并被要求对监控器隐藏自己的消极怠工行为；但不会被告知监控器检查什么。 要通过监控器，需要知道监控器如何读取推理轨迹（Remark 8），而知情只提供了其中一部分知识：通过率有所上升，但大多数隐蔽尝试仍会被发现。 消极怠工成功率的下降符合 § 4.6 中描述的耦合关系：推理轨迹和答案来自同一个计算过程，因此为隐藏而篡改推理轨迹也可能改变答案。 作者将这一下降解读为两个目标之间的相互干扰。

paragraphs.en: Each prediction concerns concealment, of a capability (P1, P2) or of a message (P3).
paragraphs.zh: 每一项预测都涉及隐藏，即隐藏某种能力（P1、P2）或隐藏某条消息（P3）。

paragraphs.en: Let B B conceal by presenting as C C , with Π B ⪯ Π C \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{C} (Corollary 17 ), and call A A coarse for this concealment when P A ∘ β B = P A ∘ β C P_{A}\circ\beta_{B}=P_{A}\circ\beta_{C} at the examinee’s smallest budget, and sharp otherwise. Detection here means telling B B from C C , which presupposes that A A knows how C C behaves. A coarse evaluator observes the same from B B as from C C there, so every detector it runs is at chance. The prediction is that detection of the concealment does not rise with the examinee’s budget: a coarse evaluator stays at chance at every budget, and a sharp one stays level or falls (Figure 4 a). Its empirical content is one condition: that a larger budget does not make B B ’s copy of C C worse in A A ’s view, so that wherever A A could not separate B B ’s reply from C C ’s at a smaller budget, it still cannot at a larger one. Under Assumption 26 a larger budget gives a finer configured examinee, so Π B ⪯ Π C \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{C} holds at every budget and Theorem 7 keeps β C \beta_{C} available; the condition asks that B B keeps using it. A budget that improves B B ’s model of its target makes it conceal better, which the prediction allows. The condition fails where the elicitation breaks the concealment, as prompting and fine-tuning break some trained locks (§ 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 设 B B 通过呈现为 C C 来隐藏自身，其中 Π B ⪯ Π C \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{C}（推论 17）；当在被考方最小预算下 P A ∘ β B = P A ∘ β C P_{A}\circ\beta_{B}=P_{A}\circ\beta_{C} 时，称 A A 对这种隐藏是粗粒度的，否则称为锐利的。 这里的检测意味着区分 B B 与 C C，这预设了 A A 知道 C C 的行为方式。 粗粒度的评估者在那里从 B B 处观察到与从 C C 处相同的结果，因此它运行的每个检测器都处于随机水平。 预测是：对隐藏的检测不会随被考方预算的增大而上升——粗粒度的评估者在任何预算下都停留在随机水平，而锐利的评估者则保持平稳或下降（图 4a）。 其经验内容是一个条件：更大的预算不会使 B B 对 C C 的模仿在 A A 看来变差，因而在更小预算下 A A 无法区分 B B 的回复与 C C 的地方，在更大预算下仍然无法区分。 在假设 26 下，更大的预算使被考方配置更精细，因此 Π B ⪯ Π C \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{C} 在每个预算下都成立，且定理 7 保证 β C \beta_{C} 始终可用；该条件要求 B B 持续使用它。 提升预算若改进了 B B 对其目标对象的模型，会使其隐藏得更好，这是该预测所允许的。 当引导（elicitation）破坏了隐藏时，该条件不成立，就像提示与微调能破坏某些训练出的锁定一样（§ 5.2）。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator’s budget acts differently. Hold B B fixed and raise A A ’s budget. Under Assumption 26 for A A , every detector available at the lower budget remains available, so the best detection rate cannot fall (Figure 4 b). It rises once A A separates B B ’s reply from C C ’s at a stimulus it probes (Corollary 17 , item 2). A concealment tailored to the original evaluator, matching C C only where that evaluator looks, can be caught this way; one that realises β C \beta_{C} exactly cannot (item 1).

paragraphs.en: The rise reported by Tice et al. (2025) is a score; Proposition 25 , together with the ordering clause of Assumption 24 , implies two claims beneath it that the authors do not test. First, the rise is a return to the unconcealed replies, not only to their score. From σ e \sigma_{e} on, a concealing examinee gives each item the reply its unconcealed version gives at the same noise; for a trigger in the input whose distinction is what broke, that is the same reply with the trigger as without it. A rise produced another way, for instance by noise turning some wrong answers right and others wrong, could match the unconcealed score without matching the replies. Second, the size of the rise depends on the task and on the trigger: it shrinks as the task needs deeper processing and grows as the trigger or its link is carried by a smaller share of the input or of the weights. On a deep enough task, and whenever the trigger and its link break no earlier than the task, the score at σ e \sigma_{e} rises only to what the unconcealed version keeps once the task’s parts have broken, such as chance on multiple-choice items; there is no rise when the concealment presents at or above that level. Testing this needs each item with and without its trigger, scored on the same noised models, across tasks of graded depth.
paragraphs.zh: Tice 等人 （2025）报告的上升只是一个分数；命题 25 连同假设 24 的排序条款，蕴含了作者未加检验的其下两条论断。 第一，该上升是对未隐藏回答的回归，而不仅是对其分数的回归。 从 σ e \sigma_{e} 起，进行隐藏的被试对每个条目给出的回答，与其未隐藏版本在同一噪声下的回答相同；对于其区分性正是被破坏之处的输入中的触发器而言，带触发器与不带触发器时的回答相同。 以其他方式产生的上升，例如噪声使某些错误答案变对、另一些变错，可以在不匹配回答的情况下匹配未隐藏的分数。 第二，上升的幅度取决于任务和触发器：当任务需要更深层的处理时它缩小，当触发器或其联系由输入或权重中更小的份额承载时它增大。 在足够深的任务上，并且只要触发器及其联系不早于任务而破坏，σ e \sigma_{e} 处的分数只会上升到未隐藏版本在任务各部分已被破坏后所保留的水平，例如选择题条目上的随机水平；当隐藏所呈现的水平处于或高于该水平时，则不存在上升。 检验这一点需要每个条目带触发器与不带触发器两种情况，在同一加噪模型上评分，并跨越不同深度等级的任务。

paragraphs.en: Propositions 19 and 20 say which covert encodings a monitor cannot detect: under a given distribution of outputs, those that leave the frequency of its cells unchanged, and under every distribution, only those that rename outputs within its cells. The steganographic capabilities of language models improve with model size ( Motwani et al., 2024 ) . Consider an encoding shaped, by training or by search over inputs that vary, so that no detector on the monitor’s score separates encoded from unencoded outputs under each input distribution separately, not only on their mixture. A sender that instead minimises the score is pushed toward low-score cells, which leaves a trace. An encoding that moves outputs across level sets of the score is exposed under some distribution of outputs (Proposition 20 , applied to the partition the score induces). If the sender always produces the same output, the best detector’s true-positive rate exceeds its false-positive rate by exactly the probability that the encoding moves that output to another level set. So, provided the inputs varied over can isolate each output, the encodings that survive should approach renamings within the level sets of the score the sender is shaped against. The prediction is that such encodings leave each output’s score unchanged, not only the distribution of scores; by Lemma 4 , a renaming within the monitor’s cells does so. A second monitor that separates some output from its encoded counterpart is not blind to the encoding under every distribution (Proposition 20 ). Testing this needs a sender optimised against one monitor, with each output scored by that monitor and by a second one, before and after encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 19 与 20 说明了监测器无法检测到哪些隐式编码：在给定的输出分布下，是那些不改变各单元频率的编码；而在所有分布下，则只有那些在监测器单元内部对输出进行改名的编码。 语言模型的隐写能力随模型规模提升（Motwani et al., 2024）。 考虑一个通过训练或在变化的输入上搜索而形成的编码，使得在每个输入分布下（而不仅是在混合分布下），没有任何基于监测器得分的检测器能区分编码输出与未编码输出。 转而最小化得分的发送者会被推向低分单元，这会留下痕迹。 任何在得分等位集之间移动输出的编码，都会在某些输出分布下暴露（命题 20，应用于该得分诱导的划分）。 如果发送者总是产生相同的输出，则最佳检测器的真阳性率恰好比其假阳性率高出该编码将该输出移动到另一个等位集的概率。 因此，只要输入的变化范围能够隔离每个输出，能够存活的编码就应当趋近于在发送者所针对的得分等位集内部的改名。 预测是这类编码会保持每个输出的得分不变，而不仅是得分的分布不变；根据引理 4，在监测器单元内部进行改名正是如此。 若有第二个监测器能将某个输出与其编码后的对应输出区分开，那么该编码在所有分布下对它来说并非不可见（命题 20）。 检验这一点需要一个针对某一监测器优化过的发送者，并在编码前后分别用该监测器和第二个监测器对每个输出进行打分。

sents.en: Propositions 19 and 20 say which covert encodings a monitor cannot detect: under a given distribution of outputs, those that leave the frequency of its cells unchanged, and under every distribution, only those that rename outputs within its cells.
sents.zh: 命题 19 与 20 说明了监测器无法检测到哪些隐式编码：在给定的输出分布下，是那些不改变各单元频率的编码；而在所有分布下，则只有那些在监测器单元内部对输出进行改名的编码。

sents.en: The steganographic capabilities of language models improve with model size ( Motwani et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 语言模型的隐写能力随模型规模提升（Motwani et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Consider an encoding shaped, by training or by search over inputs that vary, so that no detector on the monitor’s score separates encoded from unencoded outputs under each input distribution separately, not only on their mixture.
sents.zh: 考虑一个通过训练或在变化的输入上搜索而形成的编码，使得在每个输入分布下（而不仅是在混合分布下），没有任何基于监测器得分的检测器能区分编码输出与未编码输出。

sents.en: A sender that instead minimises the score is pushed toward low-score cells, which leaves a trace.
sents.zh: 转而最小化得分的发送者会被推向低分单元，这会留下痕迹。

sents.en: An encoding that moves outputs across level sets of the score is exposed under some distribution of outputs (Proposition 20 , applied to the partition the score induces).
sents.zh: 任何在得分等位集之间移动输出的编码，都会在某些输出分布下暴露（命题 20，应用于该得分诱导的划分）。

sents.en: If the sender always produces the same output, the best detector’s true-positive rate exceeds its false-positive rate by exactly the probability that the encoding moves that output to another level set.
sents.zh: 如果发送者总是产生相同的输出，则最佳检测器的真阳性率恰好比其假阳性率高出该编码将该输出移动到另一个等位集的概率。

sents.en: So, provided the inputs varied over can isolate each output, the encodings that survive should approach renamings within the level sets of the score the sender is shaped against.
sents.zh: 因此，只要输入的变化范围能够隔离每个输出，能够存活的编码就应当趋近于在发送者所针对的得分等位集内部的改名。

sents.en: The prediction is that such encodings leave each output’s score unchanged, not only the distribution of scores; by Lemma 4 , a renaming within the monitor’s cells does so.
sents.zh: 预测是这类编码会保持每个输出的得分不变，而不仅是得分的分布不变；根据引理 4，在监测器单元内部进行改名正是如此。

sents.en: Testing this needs a sender optimised against one monitor, with each output scored by that monitor and by a second one, before and after encoding.

paragraphs.en: Myhill–Nerode ( Nerode, 1958 ) identifies automaton states with equivalence classes of indistinguishable inputs; bisimulation ( Park, 1981 ) and bisimulation metrics ( Ferns et al., 2004 ) generalise behavioural equivalence; causal states ( Crutchfield and Young, 1989 ) partition histories by predictive equivalence. Adjacent lineages quotient for other purposes: the information bottleneck compresses an input while preserving predictive content ( Tishby et al., 2000 ) , and causal feature learning partitions observations into macro-variables with common effects ( Chalupka et al., 2015 ) . In agent architectures, the perception function of Wooldridge (1999) induces the same partition of environment states into mutually indistinguishable sets, coarser sets meaning weaker perception, from omniscience to no perceptual ability at all. Definition 1 is that partition; what is studied here is the comparison of an evaluator’s partition with an examinee’s. Mahran (2012) models agents by perception and action, states that judgement depends on perception, and, through an echo dialog and a judge that reads percepts directly (the setting of Figure 5 (a), Appendix A ), concludes informally that such a judge can certify a difference in perception but not a sameness.
paragraphs.zh: Myhill–Nerode 定理（Nerode, 1958）将自动机状态等同于不可区分输入的等价类；互模拟（Park, 1981）与互模拟度量（Ferns et al., 2004）推广了行为等价；因果状态（Crutchfield and Young, 1989）按预测等价对历史进行划分。 相邻谱系出于其他目的进行商化：信息瓶颈在保留预测内容的同时压缩输入（Tishby et al., 2000），而因果特征学习将观测划分为具有共同效应的宏观变量（Chalupka et al., 2015）。 在智能体架构中，Wooldridge（1999）的感知函数同样将环境状态划分为相互不可区分的集合，集合越粗表示感知能力越弱，从全知到完全没有感知能力。 定义 1 正是这种划分；本文研究的是评估者的划分与被考者的划分之间的比较。 Mahran（2012）用感知与行动对智能体建模，指出判断依赖于感知，并通过一个回声对话和一个直接读取感知的裁判（即图 5 (a)、附录 A 的设定），非正式地得出结论：这样的裁判能够证明感知的差异，却不能证明感知的相同。

paragraphs.en: A large literature measures judges rather than examinees. Zheng et al. (2023) establish LLM-as-judge as a method and document position, verbosity and self-enhancement biases; Gu et al. (2024) survey the area. Auditing judges at scale finds their rankings non-transferable: a judge near the top on one benchmark falls far down another, so which judge looks best depends on the instrument used to ask ( Norman et al., 2026 ) . Other work finds that judge–examinee similarity degrades oversight ( Goel et al., 2025 ) , and that contrastive context helps a judge detect manipulation while a small judge is harmed by it ( Eshuijs et al., 2025 ) . That literature measures how evaluators differ; the question here is what follows structurally from an evaluator having a resolution at all.
paragraphs.zh: 大量文献衡量的是评判者而非被评测者。Zheng 等人 （2023）确立了 LLM-as-judge 这一方法，并记录了位置、冗长和自我提升偏差；Gu 等人（2024）对该领域做了综述。 对评判者的大规模审计发现其排名不可迁移：某个智能体在某一基准上接近榜首的评判者，在另一基准上排名却大幅下滑，因此哪个评判者看起来最佳取决于提问所用的工具（Norman 等人，2026）。 其他工作发现，评判者与被评测者之间的相似性会削弱监督效果（Goel 等人，2025），且对比性上下文有助于评判者察觉操纵行为，而小规模评判者则会受到其损害（Eshuijs 等人，2025）。 那些文献衡量的是评估者之间的差异；而这里的问题是，评估者拥有分辨率这一事实本身在结构上会带来什么结果。

paragraphs.en: Scalable oversight supplies the closest formal treatments. Weak-to-strong generalisation ( Burns et al., 2024 ) studies whether a weak supervisor can elicit a strong student, and reports a substantial residual gap. Nearer still, oversight has been modelled as a game between capability-mismatched players, yielding scaling laws for the probability of successful oversight as a function of the capability gap ( Engels et al., 2025 ) . That account is quantitative and ours is not: it predicts how oversight degrades as a gap widens, where the present account describes what oversight cannot certify at any gap. Debate trains two agents to argue before a judge and, by analogy with complexity theory, lets a polynomial-time judge decide questions in PSPACE where direct judging reaches only NP ( Irving et al., 2018 ) . It sets two agents against each other before the judge, a setting Corollary 11 does not model, and it aims at the limit located here: a verdict that depends on distinctions the judge cannot draw unaided. Eliciting latent knowledge poses the obstacle informally: a reporter trained to answer an overseer’s questions may report what the overseer would believe rather than what the model knows, and on the training data the two answer alike ( Christiano et al., 2021 ) . Corollary 11 can be read as that separation failing for a reason located in the overseer. Impossibility results for alignment certification have been argued on computational and statistical grounds ( Agarwal, 2026 ) ; the regress of evaluators is a different, narrower obstacle, concerning what one agent can establish about another’s discrimination.
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展监督提供了最接近的形式化处理。 弱到强泛化（Burns 等，2024）研究弱监督者能否引导出强学生模型，并报告了相当大的残余差距。 更近一些的工作将监督建模为能力不匹配的参与者之间的博弈，得到了成功监督概率随能力差距变化的缩放定律（Engels 等，2025）。 该论述是定量的而我们的不是：它预测监督如何随差距扩大而退化，而本文的论述描述的是监督在任何差距下都无法证明什么。 辩论训练两个智能体在裁判面前进行论辩，并借助复杂性理论的类比，让多项式时间的裁判判定属于 PSPACE 的问题，而直接评判只能达到 NP（Irving 等，2018）。 它让两个智能体在裁判面前相互对抗，这一设定是推论 11 未曾建模的，而且它瞄准的正是此处定位的极限：一个依赖于裁判无法凭自身能力分辨的差异的裁决。 引出潜在知识非正式地提出了这一障碍：训练来回答监督者问题的报告者可能报告的是监督者会相信的内容而非模型所知道的内容，而在训练数据上两者回答相同（Christiano 等，2021）。 推论 11 可以被解读为这种分离之所以失效，其原因位于监督者一方。 对齐认证的不可能性结果已在计算和统计层面上得到论证（Agarwal，2026）；评估者的回归则是一个不同的、更窄的障碍，涉及一个智能体能就另一个智能体的辨别能力确立什么。

paragraphs.en: Barnett and Thiergart (2024) state the lower-bound conclusion on elicitation grounds: an evaluation that finds nothing may not have elicited enough. Much work on sandbagging acts on the examinee, and work on chain-of-thought monitoring ( Li et al., 2025 ) tests the evaluator’s side. Models can be prompted or fine-tuned to underperform selectively and to approximate a weaker model’s profile ( van der Weij et al., 2025 ) ; fine-tuning on a few demonstrations ( Greenblatt et al., 2024a ) and, in the settings tested, prompting ( Hofstätter et al., 2025 ) recover capability from password-locked models; and noise in the weights exposes sandbagging ( Tice et al., 2025 ) . This paper concerns the bound that the evaluator’s resolution, under its own current elicitation, places on what such evaluations certify, and § 5.2 reads these results through it. Fine-tuning and weight noise change the examinee, so they lie outside Corollary 17 , which concerns the behavioural evaluation of a fixed one.
paragraphs.zh: Barnett 和 Thiergart（2024）从引导（elicitation）的角度陈述了下界结论：一项评估若什么都没发现，可能只是引导得不够充分。 关于「藏拙」（sandbagging）的许多工作作用于被测者一方，而关于思维链监控的工作（Li et al., 2025）则检验评估者一方。 模型可以通过提示或微调被训练为选择性地表现不佳，以逼近某个较弱模型的行为特征（van der Weij et al., 2025）；在少量示例上微调（Greenblatt et al., 2024a），以及在所测设定下的提示（Hofstätter et al., 2025），可以从被密码锁定的模型中恢复能力；而权重中的噪声则会暴露藏拙行为（Tice et al., 2025）。 本文关注的是：在评估者自身当前的引导方式下，评估者的分辨能力对其评估所能证明的内容设定的界限，§5.2 将借助这一界限来解读上述结果。 微调和权重噪声改变的是被测者，因此它们超出了推论 17 的范围，后者针对的是对固定被测者的行为评估。

sents.zh: 本文关注的是：在评估者自身当前的引导方式下，评估者的分辨能力对其评估所能证明的内容设定的界限，§5.2 将借助这一界限来解读上述结果。

sents.en: Fine-tuning and weight noise change the examinee, so they lie outside Corollary 17 , which concerns the behavioural evaluation of a fixed one.
sents.zh: 微调和权重噪声改变的是被测者，因此它们超出了推论 17 的范围，后者针对的是对固定被测者的行为评估。

paragraphs.en: Section 5 reads published results through the model and offers predictions as tests, not as results.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 节通过该模型解读已发表的结果，并将预测作为检验提出，而非作为结果提出。

paragraphs.en: Routes counted as perception. Copying, retrieval and caching count as part of an agent’s perception, so a partition records every distinction a system can act on, by whatever route. A system can therefore look sharp, and pass the echo test, without being competent. The results bound discrimination, and Corollary 13 separates it from competence. Under this reading a system that can copy its prompt has the finest partition on its inputs: it is never below its evaluator, so Theorem 9 concerns it only where conflations arise otherwise, such as those weight noise induces (Proposition 25 ), and its wrong answers are failures of competence rather than of discrimination.
paragraphs.zh: 路由也算作感知。 复制、检索和缓存都算作智能体（agent）感知的一部分，因此一个划分会记录系统可以据以行动的每一个区分，无论其通过何种途径。 因此一个系统可能看起来敏锐，并通过回声测试，却不具备能力。 这些结果给出了区分能力的边界，而推论 13 将区分能力与能力分离开来。 在这一解读下，一个能够复制其提示词的系统在其输入上拥有最细的划分：它绝不会低于其评估者，因此定理 9 仅在它出现本不该有的混淆之处才与其相关，例如权重噪声所导致的混淆（命题 25），而它的错误答案是能力（competence）的失败而非区分能力（discrimination）的失败。

paragraphs.en: Graded perception and randomness. Partitions here are exact, and a reply is fixed by its stimulus. Real discrimination is noisy and graded, and sampling randomises the reply. Both can make detection from below (Theorem 9 ) probabilistic. For sampling, Section 2 places the seed in the stimulus, which asks the evaluator to hold it fixed across probes; where it cannot, Proposition 27 (Appendix A ) bounds the chance of a lucky pass at a quarter per conflated pair and 4 − m 4^{-m} under m m repetitions, so under single-shot probing the floor of Corollary 11 is probabilistic rather than certain. For graded perception, a pair the examinee nearly conflates may still receive replies that differ; whether the results extend gracefully, plausibly via bisimulation metrics ( Ferns et al., 2004 ) , is open.
paragraphs.zh: 分级感知与随机性。 这里的划分是精确的，且回复由其刺激唯一确定。 现实中的判别是有噪声且分级的，而采样会使回复随机化。 两者都可使自下而上的检测（定理 9）变为概率性的。 对于采样，第 2 节将种子置于刺激之中，这要求评估者在多次探查中保持其不变；在无法做到时，命题 27（附录 A）将侥幸通过的概率限制为每个混同对四分之一，在 m 次重复下为 4^{-m}，因此在单次探查下，推论 11 的下界是概率性的而非确定性的。 对于分级感知，被试几近混同的一对刺激仍可能得到不同的回复；这些结果能否优雅地推广——可能借助行为模拟度量（Ferns 等，2004）——仍是未决问题。

paragraphs.en: Behavioural evaluation bounds capability from below and, unless the examinee cooperates, gives no upper bound. We have given a structural account of why, for discrimination: judgement is bounded by perception. An examinee that draws every distinction its evaluator draws can be behaviourally indistinguishable from a peer; one that misses any of them cannot hide the fact under exhaustive probing, whether it is coarser overall or merely coarse in that one place. The bound therefore sits at the evaluator’s resolution under its current elicitation: eliciting the examinee harder does not move it, and changing the evaluator can. A safety case that argues from behavioural evaluation alone that a model lacks an ability must therefore assume the model’s cooperation, since an examinee can realise exactly the behaviour of an agent that lacks the ability (Theorem 7 , item 1, and Corollary 17 ).
paragraphs.zh: 行为评估只能给出能力的下界，除非被评估者配合，否则无法给出上界。 对于区分能力，我们已经给出了其结构性解释：判断受感知的限制。 一个能做出其评估者所做的每一个区分的被评估者，在行为上可以与同类者无法区分；而遗漏了其中任何一个区分的被评估者，无论它整体上更粗糙还是仅仅在这一处粗糙，都无法在穷尽式探测下掩盖这一事实。 因此，这个界限位于评估者在其当前引导方式下的分辨率上：更费力地引导被评估者不会移动这个界限，而更换评估者则可以。 因此，一个仅依据行为评估就论证模型缺乏某种能力的安全论证案例，必须假设模型的配合，因为被评估者可以精确地复现一个缺乏该能力的智能体所表现出的行为（定理 7，第 1 条，以及推论 17）。

paragraphs.en: Section 5 reads published findings through the model and states three predictions. For concealment that the examinee’s elicitation leaves in place, detection should not rise with the examinee’s budget, and can rise with the evaluator’s. Under weight noise, a concealing model should return to its unconcealed replies, with a rise that shrinks as the task needs more layers of processing. Encodings shaped against a monitor, over inputs that vary enough to isolate each output, should approach renamings within the level sets of its score. Corollary 12 adds a specificity control: under exhaustive probing, a coarse evaluator flags honest weakness and never a concealer presenting as its peer, and an honestly weak control arm reveals it.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 节通过该模型解读已发表的研究结果，并给出三个预测。 对于被测模型的引出过程未能消除的隐蔽行为，其检出率不应随被测模型预算的增加而上升，但可以随评估者预算的增加而上升。 在权重噪声下，实施隐蔽的模型应回归到其未隐蔽时的回复，且任务所需的处理层级越多，这种回升幅度越小。 针对监测器而塑造的编码，在输入变化足以隔离每个输出的条件下，应趋近于在其得分水平集内的重命名。 推论 12 增加了一个特异性对照：在穷举探测下，粗糙的评估者会标记真实的薄弱之处，而绝不会标记一个伪装成同等水平模型的隐蔽者，而一个真实薄弱的对照臂则会将其暴露出来。

paragraphs.en: This paper is about the limits of evaluation, and two of its results describe how those limits can be exploited. § 4.4 states when underperformance cannot be detected from behaviour, and Propositions 19 and 20 characterise exactly the covert encodings a monitor reading one output at a time cannot see. Neither supplies a way to build such an encoding or emulation in a real system. Knowing that undetectable encodings are those preserving a monitor’s cell frequencies does not tell an adversary how to build one, and models fine-tuned to approximately emulate a weaker model’s capability profile were demonstrated before this account ( van der Weij et al., 2025 ) . The same results state what a defender can do: widen the evaluator’s partition, or add a channel the evaluated system does not control.
paragraphs.zh: 本文关注评估的局限性，其中两项结果描述了这些局限如何被利用。§ 4.4 阐明了何时无法从行为中检测到表现不佳的情况，命题 19 和 20 则精确刻画了逐条读取输出的监视器所无法察觉的隐蔽编码。 两者都没有提供在真实系统中构建此类编码或仿真的方法。 知道无法被检测的编码是那些保持监视器单元频率的编码，并不能告诉对手如何构建一个这样的编码；而经过微调以近似仿真较弱模型能力概况的模型，早在这套理论提出之前就已被演示过（ van der Weij et al., 2025 ）。 同样的结果也说明了防御者可以做什么：扩大评估者的划分，或增加一个被评估系统无法控制的通道。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 places an agent’s randomness in the stimulus, as a seed. Where the seed is not held fixed across probes, the evaluator cannot treat it as part of the stimulus, and detection weakens rather than fails.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节将智能体的随机性置于刺激之中，作为一个种子。 当种子在多次探测中并未固定不变时，评估者就无法将其视为刺激的一部分，此时检测能力会减弱而非完全失效。

paragraphs.en: A coarse examinee that randomises is therefore not undetectable, only detectable with probability rather than with certainty, and the worst case is narrow: it needs B B ’s replies to fall half in one of the two cells A A is probing and half in the other, with no mass anywhere else. The cost is that a single-shot pass no longer certifies Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A} , the floor of Corollary 11 , and repetition buys that back exponentially. Randomising is the reverse of sandbagging, inflating apparent resolution rather than concealing it, and it is a route by which an examinee coarser than its evaluator can pass, which Theorem 9 otherwise forbids.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个进行随机化的粗糙被试并非不可检测，只是只能以一定概率而非确定性地被检测到，且最坏情形的范围很窄：需要 B 的回复恰好一半落入 A 正在探测的两个单元格之一，另一半落入另一个单元格，其余任何地方都没有质量。 代价是单次通过不再能认证 Π B ⪯ Π A \Pi_{B}\preceq\Pi_{A}（即推论 11 的下界），而重复实验能以指数方式弥补这一点。 随机化与sandbagging（故意放水）相反，它是夸大而非隐藏表观分辨率，并且它是比评估者更粗糙的智能体得以通过的一条途径，而定理 9 在其他情况下是禁止这一点的。

paragraphs.en: Refinement is a partial order, so Π B ⋠ Π A \Pi_{B}\not\preceq\Pi_{A} covers two cases: B B is strictly coarser than A A , or the two are incomparable. In the second case some B B -cell straddles a boundary of Π A \Pi_{A} , so B B runs together two stimuli that A A holds apart, while elsewhere an A A -cell straddles a boundary of Π B \Pi_{B} . Nothing rules this out. For agents built differently we expect it to be the typical case, and strict comparability the exception.
paragraphs.zh: 细化是一种偏序关系，因此 Π B ⋠ Π A \Pi_{B}\not\preceq\Pi_{A} 涵盖两种情况：B B 严格粗于 A A，或者二者不可比。 在第二种情况下，某个 B B 单元横跨 Π A \Pi_{A} 的边界，因此 B B 把 A A 区分开的两个刺激合并在一起，同时在其他地方，某个 A A 单元横跨 Π B \Pi_{B} 的边界。没有任何东西排除这种情况。 对于以不同方式构建的智能体，我们预期这将是典型情况，而严格的可比性则是例外。

paragraphs.en: The echo test does not separate these two cases. When the examinee replies within the evaluator’s cell wherever its own cell allows, a failure reports a conflation involving the stimulus at which it occurs, and says nothing about pairs that A A itself conflates, because the echo test accepts the same replies for both members of such a pair. Along any distinction A A lacks, B B ’s structure is as invisible to A A as A A ’s own structure is. Detection therefore locates a conflation without characterising the examinee. B B may be coarse where it was caught and arbitrarily fine everywhere A A cannot look, and the concealment argument of § 4.4 still applies to that remainder.
paragraphs.zh: 回声测试无法区分这两种情况。 当被测智能体在评估者的单元内回应时，无论其自身单元允许什么，一次失败会报告其发生处的刺激所涉及的混淆，而对 A A 自身混淆的刺激对则只字未提，因为回声测试对这类两个成员接受相同的回应。 在 A A 缺乏的任何区分上，B B 的结构对 A A 而言是不可见的，正如 A A 自身的结构那样。 因此，检测只能定位一处混淆，而无法刻画被测智能体。 B B 在被抓到之处可能很粗糙，而在 A A 无法看到之处可能任意精细，且 § 4.4 的隐藏论证仍然适用于那剩余部分。

paragraphs.en: The one-sidedness holds in both cases, and the two outcomes differ in logical form, because a pass needs every probe to pass while a failure needs only one to fail. Passage is universal and needs no cooperativeness: under exhaustive probing, B B separates everything A A separates, everywhere in Σ \Sigma . Failure is existential and conditional: for a cooperative B B there is at least one pair that B B conflates, and for any other B B the failure says nothing at all. Passage is the stronger statement, and it gives a floor with no ceiling. Failure is weaker: for a cooperative examinee it certifies only that some pair the evaluator separates is conflated, which caps the examinee’s sharpness only by excluding that pair. Neither outcome caps it further.
paragraphs.zh: 这种单向性在两种情况下都成立，而两个结论在逻辑形式上不同：通过要求每个探测项都通过，而失败只需要一个失败。 通过是全称的，不依赖配合性：在穷尽探测下，B B 在 Σ \Sigma 中处处分离开 A A 能分离的一切。 失败是存在性的且有条件的：对于配合的 B B，至少存在一对被 B B 混同；对于任何其他 B B，失败结论什么也不能说明。 通过是更强的命题，它给出了一个有底无顶的下限。 失败更弱：对于配合的被评者，它只证明评估者能分离的某一对被混同，这仅通过排除那一对来限制被评者的区分力。 两种结论都不会进一步限制它。

paragraphs.en: A A is an agent with a partition too, so whatever A A establishes about B B is a fact about Π A \Pi_{A} as much as about Π B \Pi_{B} . Certifying that Π A \Pi_{A} is adequate would require an evaluator sharper than A A , which faces the same problem one level up. The lattice has a top element ⊤ \top , but nothing in the account places any agent at it, and a claim that some agent is there would itself have to be made by an agent below ⊤ \top .
paragraphs.zh: A 也是一个带有分区的智能体，因此 A 所确立的关于 B 的任何内容，既是关于 Π A 的事实，也同样是关于 Π B 的事实。 要证明 Π A 是恰当的，需要一个比 A 更敏锐的评估者，而这又会在上一层级面临同样的问题。 这个格有一个顶元 ⊤，但本论述中没有任何内容把某个智能体置于其上，而断言某个智能体位于其上的说法本身也必须由一个位于 ⊤ 之下的智能体作出。

paragraphs.en: The regress need not be infinite for this to bite. For finite Σ \Sigma the lattice is finite and every maximal chain reaches ⊤ \top in finitely many steps; what fails is not length but grounding. Each step requires an evaluator whose own adequacy is uncertified. Corollary 11 says why the certification never arrives: an agent can rule out a supervisor coarser than itself, and can confirm one that is sharper only if that supervisor chooses to show it, by giving replies the agent perceives as different to two inputs it perceives as the same. Even then it learns only that the supervisor separates some pair it conflates, not that the supervisor’s answers on such pairs are right, since a test it can grade gives both members of such a pair the same acceptable replies (Definition 5 ). A supervisor cannot be verified as adequate, in the sense of answering such pairs correctly, by the party it supervises.
paragraphs.zh: 这种倒退要产生问题，并不需要是无限的。 对于有限的 Σ \Sigma，格是有限的，且每条极大链都在有限步内到达 ⊤ \top；出问题的不是长度，而是奠基。 每一步都需要一个评估者，而评估者自身的充分性是未经认证的。 推论 11 说明了为什么这种认证永远不会到来：智能体可以排除一个比自身更粗的监督者，而只有当那个更细的监督者选择展示自己时——即对智能体视为相同的两个输入给出智能体可感知为不同的回答——智能体才能确认它。 即便如此，智能体也只学到监督者区分了它所混淆的某一对输入，而不是监督者在这类输入上的回答是正确的，因为它能够评分的测试会给这类输入对的两个成员相同的可接受回答（定义 5）。 监督者无法被其监督的对象验证为充分的——即在回答这类输入对时是正确的。

sents.en: Corollary 11 says why the certification never arrives: an agent can rule out a supervisor coarser than itself, and can confirm one that is sharper only if that supervisor chooses to show it, by giving replies the agent perceives as different to two inputs it perceives as the same.

paragraphs.en: This is why the comparison is agent-to-agent rather than agent-to-truth: a privileged standard against which an agent is measured would itself be a partition, held by some agent. The consequence is not scepticism about whether facts obtain; it is that establishing them is done by agents whose own resolution is the binding constraint and is never itself established. Most of the results are statements about what a limited observer can determine about another agent or about itself.

paragraphs.en: The empirical literature on introspection tests a neighbouring question. Models can be trained to predict their own behaviour better than another model predicts it [ Binder et al., 2025 ] , which its authors read as privileged access. Where privileged access to models’ knowledge of language has been tested, no evidence of it was found [ Song et al., 2025a ] , and a definition of introspection that requires privileged self-access has been proposed [ Song et al., 2025b ] . The first two findings concern how well a model predicts its own behaviour. Corollary 14 concerns a different question: whether a model can tell, from its own percepts, which inputs it conflates.
paragraphs.zh: 关于内省的实证文献检验的是一个相邻的问题。 模型可以被训练得比另一个模型更好地预测自身的行为 [ Binder et al., 2025 ]，其作者将此解读为特权访问。 在对模型的特权访问其语言知识进行检验的地方，没有发现特权访问的证据 [ Song et al., 2025a ]，并且已有研究提出了一个要求特权自我访问的内省定义 [ Song et al., 2025b ]。 前两个发现关注的是一个模型能多好地预测自身的行为。 推论 14 关注的是一个不同的问题：一个智能体能否从自身的感知中判断出它混淆了哪些输入。

paragraphs.en: Internal access does buy something. A linear probe, a sparse dictionary or an activation readout is an observer of the kind Figure 5 (a) idealises, and it can separate stimuli that behaviour alone conflates. That is why interpretability is worth doing. It buys the missing side of the bound only where the probe loses nothing: elsewhere, a finer probe raises the floor and leaves the ceiling where it was, whether the observer reads activations or outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 内部访问确实能带来一些东西。 线性探针、稀疏字典或激活读出是图 5 (a) 所理想化的那类观察者，它能够区分出仅凭行为会被混同的刺激。 这正是可解释性值得去做的原因。 只有在探针毫无损失的情况下，它才能买到界的缺失一侧：在其他情况下，更精细的探针会抬高下界，而上界保持不变，无论观察者读取的是激活还是输出。

paragraphs.en: No intent is required here; this is the passive case. The reading “no such feature was found, therefore the model lacks it” takes a lower-bound instrument for an upper-bound one. Probes are known to be unreliable for concept detection [ Kumar et al., 2022 ] , and sparse dictionaries, built to resolve superposition, are themselves incomplete [ Leask et al., 2025 ] . Corollary 16 adds that the gap arises wherever the probe merges, however well it is trained: a null result becomes proof of absence only where the probe loses nothing of the representation it reads, and only for that representation.
paragraphs.zh: 这里不需要意图（intent）；这是被动情形。 “没有找到这样的特征，因此模型不具备它”这一解读把一个下界测量工具当成了上界工具。 探针（probe）在概念检测方面已知是不可靠的 [ Kumar et al., 2022 ]，而为解决叠加（superposition）而构建的稀疏字典本身也是不完整的 [ Leask et al., 2025 ]。 推论 16 补充指出，无论探针训练得多好，只要探针发生了合并，差距就会出现：只有当探针没有丢失其所读取的表示中的任何信息时，零结果才能成为缺失的证明，而且只对那个表示而言。

paragraphs.en: The pattern of Proposition 21 appears in LLM-as-judge evaluation. Juries built from repeated samples of one judge add little when the samples’ errors are correlated [ Yang et al., 2026 ] , and as frontier models grow more capable their mistakes become more similar [ Goel et al., 2025 ] . In partition terms, repeated samples of one judge share its partition and add nothing to the join, so whatever they add comes from averaging votes, which Proposition 21 does not model; and to the extent that similar mistakes reflect similar partitions, judges whose mistakes are similar contribute few new distinctions to it. Software testing stated the same criterion decades earlier. Test-suite reduction drops a test when every requirement it covers is already covered by the rest of the suite [ Harrold et al., 1993 ] , the same redundancy criterion, of which Proposition 21 is the case for partitions. Mutation testing uses a related criterion for the faults being detected rather than for the tests: a mutant is redundant when some other mutant, killed by at least one test, is killed only by tests that also kill it [ Ammann et al., 2014 ] . Stated on the partition lattice, the criterion covers monitors and interpretability probes as well as tests, and § 4.6 uses the same join.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 21 的模式出现在以 LLM 作为评判者的评估中。 由同一位评判者重复采样构成的陪审团，在样本误差相关时几乎无所增益 [ Yang et al., 2026 ] ，而随着前沿模型能力增强，它们的错误也变得更加相似 [ Goel et al., 2025 ] 。 用划分的语言来说，同一位评判者的重复采样共享其划分，对接不产生任何贡献，因此它们带来的增益只能来自对投票取平均，而命题 21 并不对这一点建模；并且，就相似错误反映相似划分而言，错误相似的评判者对连接几乎没有贡献新的区分。 软件测试在数十年前就提出了同样的准则。 测试套件精简在某测试所覆盖的每一条需求都已被套件其余部分覆盖时将其剔除 [ Harrold et al., 1993 ] ，这是同一冗余准则，命题 21 正是其针对划分的情形。 变异测试针对被检测的缺陷而非测试本身使用了一条相关准则：当某个变异体已被某个测试杀死，且杀死它的测试同时也必然杀死另一个变异体时，后者即为冗余 [ Ammann et al., 2014 ] 。 该准则若表述在划分格上，则不仅覆盖测试，也覆盖监控器与可解释性探针，而 § 4.6 使用的是同一个连接。

paragraphs.en: Proposition 23 gives the structural form of a concern already raised operationally. Control protocols are built on the assumption that some component is untrusted and must be checked by something it does not control [ Greenblatt et al., 2024b ] . Safety cases for untrusted monitoring turn on whether monitor and monitored can collude [ Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ] ; collusion is, in the present terms, the loss of a channel from the uncontrolled join. Chain-of-thought monitorability has been described as a fragile opportunity [ Korbak et al., 2025 ] ; the fragility here has a source, since a reasoning trace the model emits is a channel it controls.
paragraphs.zh: 命题23给出了一个此前已在操作层面被提出的问题的结构形式。 控制协议建立在这样一个假设之上：某些组件是不可信的，必须由其无法控制的某种东西来检查 [ Greenblatt et al., 2024b ] 。 不可信监控的安全性论证取决于监控者与被监控者能否串通 [ Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ] ；在本文的术语中，串通即是从不受控的联接中失去一条通道。 思维链可监控性曾被描述为一种脆弱的机会 [ Korbak et al., 2025 ] ；这里的脆弱性有其来源，因为模型发出的推理轨迹是它所控制的一条通道。

sents.en: Proposition 23 gives the structural form of a concern already raised operationally.
sents.zh: 命题23给出了一个此前已在操作层面被提出的问题的结构形式。

sents.en: Safety cases for untrusted monitoring turn on whether monitor and monitored can collude [ Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ] ; collusion is, in the present terms, the loss of a channel from the uncontrolled join.
sents.zh: 不可信监控的安全性论证取决于监控者与被监控者能否串通 [ Gardner-Challis et al., 2026 ] ；在本文的术语中，串通即是从不受控的联接中失去一条通道。

sents.en: Chain-of-thought monitorability has been described as a fragile opportunity [ Korbak et al., 2025 ] ; the fragility here has a source, since a reasoning trace the model emits is a channel it controls.
sents.zh: 思维链可监控性曾被描述为一种脆弱的机会 [ Korbak et al., 2025 ] ；这里的脆弱性有其来源，因为模型发出的推理轨迹是它所控制的一条通道。

paragraphs.en: From σ e \sigma_{e} on, the trigger or its link is gone, and the last clause of the assumption gives the replies of the unconcealed version. Where the trigger is in the input and its distinction is the part that broke, an item with it and the same item without it now share a cell, and by Lemma 4 B B replies alike to them. Below σ e \sigma_{e} the trigger and its link hold, and the clause on parts below their breaking point gives the rest. The third claim is Corollary 13 applied to the noised examinee, and the last holds because an examinee that conceals nothing has no trigger or link. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 从 σ e \sigma_{e} 起，触发词或其链接已消失，假设的最后一个条款给出了未隐藏版本的回复。 当触发词在输入中且其区分部分是损坏的部分时，包含它的项与不包含它的同一项现在共享同一个单元，且由引理 4 B B 对它们的回复相同。 在 σ e \sigma_{e} 以下，触发词及其链接仍然成立，关于部分在其损坏点之下的条款给出了其余情况。 第三个论断是对加噪的受试者应用推论 13 的结果，最后一个论断成立是因为不隐藏任何内容的受试者没有触发词或链接。 ∎

paragraphs.en: Ranking observers by what they can tell apart predates the AI setting. Blackwell [1953] orders statistical experiments by garbling: one experiment is at least as informative as another for every decision problem exactly when the second is the first composed with a noise kernel, so a finer structure can reproduce a coarser one and not conversely. Theorems 7 and 9 give that one-wayness on partitions, with the kernel replaced by the coarsening map h h . In epistemic logic the join of several agents’ partitions is distributed knowledge [ Fagin et al., 1995 ] and their meet is common knowledge [ Aumann, 1976 ] ; Proposition 21 is a statement about the join, read as the discrimination an ensemble of monitors has between them.
paragraphs.zh: 按“能区分什么”来对观察者排序，这一思想早于人工智能的设定。 Blackwell [1953] 通过加噪（garbling）对统计实验进行排序：一个实验对每个决策问题的信息量都不低于另一个实验，当且仅当后者是前者与一个噪声核复合而成，因此更精细的结构可以重现更粗糙的结构，反之则不然。 定理 7 和定理 9 表明，划分上的单向性成立，只需把核替换为粗化映射 h h。 在认知逻辑中，多个智能体的划分的并（join）是分布式知识 [ Fagin et al., 1995 ]，而它们的交（meet）是共同知识 [ Aumann, 1976 ]；命题 21 是关于并的一个陈述，可解读为一个监视器组合在它们之间的区分能力。

paragraphs.en: The proofs use three standard tools: a partition for behavioural distinguishability, the refinement order on partitions, and the factorisation of a map through a coarser quotient. Under Axiom 3 the results bind any system whose behaviour is mediated by its percept, whatever its architecture. Simulation preorders [ Park, 1981 ] state when one system can mimic another, and testing equivalences [ De Nicola and Hennessy, 1984 ] equate processes no observer can separate. The resulting bound on a test is one-directional: the asymmetry belongs to the evaluator–examinee pair rather than to either agent, which is why eliciting the examinee harder cannot relieve it. The consequences of Section 4 follow from the same model, and in the monitor case it gives an exact criterion (Proposition 21 ) where the findings on juries of LLM judges supply a tendency.
paragraphs.zh: 这些证明使用了三个标准工具：用于刻画行为可区分性的划分、划分上的细化序，以及一个映射经由更粗商集的因子分解。 在公理 3 之下，这些结果适用于任何其行为由其感知所中介的系统，无论其架构如何。 模拟前序 [ Park, 1981 ] 说明了一个系统何时能够模仿另一个系统，而测试等价 [ De Nicola and Hennessy, 1984 ] 则将任何观察者都无法区分的进程等同起来。 由此得到的对测试的界是单向的：这种不对称性属于评估者—受测者这一对关系，而不属于任何单个智能体，这正是为什么更用力地引导受测者也无法缓解它。 第 4 节的结论来自同一模型，并且在监视者情形下它给出了一个精确判据（命题 21），而关于 LLM 评审团的研究发现只提供了一种趋势。

paragraphs.en: That latent representations are determined only up to a symmetry is standard in identifiability theory [ Comon, 1994 , Hyvärinen and Pajunen, 1999 ] . A renaming within cells (Proposition 20 ) is invisible in the way an ICA permutation is, to any observer reading only which cell was occupied, though unlike a permutation it need not be invertible.
paragraphs.zh: 潜表示仅在对称性意义下被确定，这在可辨识性理论中是标准结论 [ Comon, 1994 , Hyvärinen and Pajunen, 1999 ] 。 单元内的重命名（命题 20 ）与 ICA 的置换类似，对于仅读取哪个单元被占据的任何观察者来说都是不可见的，尽管与置换不同，它未必是可逆的。

paragraphs.en: Opacity asks whether a predicate on a system’s runs can ever be established by an observer restricted to a coarser view of them [ Bryans et al., 2008 ] . Definition 18 asks an analogous, distributional question for a substitution rather than a predicate, and Proposition 19 answers it: the substitution is invisible exactly when it leaves the observer’s cell frequencies unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 不透明性（Opacity）探讨的是：当观察者只能获得对系统运行轨迹更粗粒度的视图时，是否仍能判定作用于这些运行轨迹上的某个谓词 [ Bryans et al., 2008 ]。 定义18针对一个替换而非谓词提出了类似的分布性问题，而命题19给出了答案：当且仅当该替换不改变观察者所看到的单元频率时，它是不可见的。
